Salesforce Files

With the new Scan files for viruses or malware (beta) setting, users are blocked from uploading or
downloading malicious files. The file size limit has increased from 2 GB to 10 GB. And to keep your files
list organized and tidy, you can now enable more users to delete files that they don’t own. Several of
these features are ones that you requested on IdeaExchange.

  Protect Your Salesforce Org and Users by Scanning Files for Malware (Beta)
  For improved security in your Salesforce org, files are now scanned for malware in Salesforce Files.


                                                                                                                       505

Salesforce Release Notes Experience Cloud

  When a user tries to upload a file, the process is blocked if the scanned file is malicious. If a malicious
  file is uploaded via the API, it’s scanned asynchronously, and it appears in the new Malicious Files
  (Beta) list. When a user attempts to download an existing file, the download is blocked if it’s malicious.
  This feature was developed based on your idea on IdeaExchange.
  Manage Files up to 10 GB in Salesforce Files
  Salesforce Files has increased the file size limit from 2 GB to 10 GB. The increased limit is available to
  Files home, libraries, and on a record’s Files related list, but not to files uploaded to Chatter or LWR
  sites in Experience Cloud.
  Allow More Users to Delete Files
  Manage files in Salesforce more efficiently by assigning the new Delete Salesforce Files permission to
  your users. With this permission, a user can delete any file that they have access to view. Previously,
  only a Salesforce admin or the file owner could delete a file. This feature was developed based on your
  idea on IdeaExchange.
  Launch a Flow When a User Changes a File (Beta)
  To launch a flow when a user creates, updates, or deletes a file, set up the flow so that it triggers on
  the Content Document or Content Version objects. Use this new feature to create flows that work with
  documents in Salesforce Files or Salesforce CRM content. This feature was developed based on your
  idea on IdeaExchange.

Protect Your Salesforce Org and Users by Scanning Files for Malware (Beta)

For improved security in your Salesforce org, files are now scanned for malware in Salesforce Files. When
a user tries to upload a file, the process is blocked if the scanned file is malicious. If a malicious file is
uploaded via the API, it’s scanned asynchronously, and it appears in the new Malicious Files (Beta) list.
When a user attempts to download an existing file, the download is blocked if it’s malicious. This feature
was developed based on your idea on IdeaExchange.

Where: This change applies to Salesforce Files accessed through Lightning Experience and Salesforce
Classic in Essentials, Group, Enterprise, Professional, Performance, Unlimited, Contact Manager, and
Developer editions hosted on Hyperforce.

     Note Scan files for viruses or malware is a pilot or beta service that is subject to the Beta Services
     Terms at Agreements - Salesforce.com or a written Unified Pilot Agreement if executed by Customer,
     and applicable terms in the Product Terms Directory. Use of this pilot or beta service is at the
     Customer's sole discretion.

When: This functionality is available on a rolling basis starting in Spring ’26. For details about timing and
eligibility, contact your Salesforce account executive.

Who: File owners, or users who have access to a file that was shared with them, can view a file even if it’s
malicious. To access the Malicious Files (Beta) list and all identified malicious files or to download
malicious files, you need the Manage Malicious Files (Beta) user permission. To only download malicious
files, you need the Download Malicious Files (Beta) user permission.




    506

Salesforce Release Notes Experience Cloud

How: From Setup, in the Quick Find box, enter Files, and then select Salesforce Files | General
Settings. The setting Scan files for viruses or malware (beta) is turned on by default. If a new file isn’t
scanned during the initial upload, it’s scanned asynchronously and added to the Malicious Files List
(Beta) if it contains malware.

Field Service Desktop Monthly Updates

Field Service Platform and Managed Package patch notes.

February '26

•  Managed Package (260.5 and 260.6)
    - Fixed an issue where Dispatcher Console could still send network requests in the background after
     your session became inactive, even though a blocking refresh message was shown.
    - Fixed an issue where dates and times were wrong during appointment booking for the Israel-
     Hebrew locale because that locale code wasn't mapped to a supported Hebrew value for the date
     library.


                            514

Salesforce Release Notes        Field Service

    - Fixed an issue where scheduling optimization could return the wrong HTTP response when multiple
        optimization requests ran at the same time.
    - Fixed an issue where unscheduling a dispatched service appointment failed with a validation error
        while calendar events and assigned resources were being cleaned up during calendar sync.
    - Fixed an issue where the next and previous controls in Dispatcher Console long-term view did not
        move the visible schedule forward or backward by a full week.
    - Fixed an issue where the resource availability service returned shifts that extended beyond the
        requested start and end dates in full instead of trimming them to the range specified.
    - Fixed an issue where a long-running scheduling optimization could cause a later scheduling or rules
        operation to time out sooner than expected.

January '26

•  Managed Package (260.3 and 260.4)
    - Fixed an issue where drag and drop failed because the service territory member definition was
        missing.
    - Fixed an issue where Unscheduled Service Appointments was populated even though it should
        have been 0.
    - Fixed an issue where rule validation failed because there was no access to one of the service
        appointments in the complex work chain.
    - Fixed an issue where Resource Schedule Optimization ignored the Required Resource Preference for
        service appointments that were outside the domain.
    - Fixed an issue where incorrect travel times were calculated when an absence was fully contained
        within a scheduled service appointment.
    --  Fixed an issue where Relevance Groups didn’t work with the Extended Match work rule.
        Fixed an issue where the optimization request failed because a scheduled service appointment had
        a dependency with a canceled service appointment.
    - Fixed an issue where the Gantt scrolled 24 hours instead of 3 hours when moving forward or
        backward in the In Day view.
    --  Fixed an issue where the Data Cloud connection failed during the TLS handshake.
        Fixed an issue where resource availability was silently dropped on certain days due to conflict.
    --  Fixed an issue where ids were added to the Travel To or Travel From field tooltips on the Gantt.
        Fixed an issue where the SchedStartTime filter excluded unscheduled service appointments with
        dependencies.
    - Fixed an issue where the parsing of numbers in the rule violation text was incorrect.

November '25

•  Platform (258.10 and 258.11)
    --  Fixed an issue where a work capacity limit of 0% was not being enforced.
        Fixed an issue where the CSI (Conversation Service Integration) invocable action required accountId
        as a mandatory input parameter, causing errors when Work Orders didn't have an associated
•       Account.
   Managed Package (258.7 and 258.8)



        515

Salesforce Release Notes        Field Service

    - Optimized SOQL queries in the InDay composite API to reduce query count and stay within limits
        during concurrent operations.
    - Fixed an issue where travel calculations incorrectly used shift intervals from the secondary Service
        Territory Membership when the primary territory had no availability.
    - Fixed an issue where travel times were missing when service appointments were dragged and
        dropped onto holiday shifts in the flow.

October '25

•  Platform (258.8 and 258.9)
    --  Fixed an issue where sorting on the name in the work order related list caused high CPU usage.
        Fixed the step "Let service resources access their dispatched service appointments and related work
        orders" in the Field Service Initial Setup in Salesforce Go.
    - Fixed an issue where the SFS Studio Setup Enabled permission was incorrectly set to true by default
        in new Unlimited, Enterprise, and Professional Edition orgs. This permission will no longer be
        enabled automatically upon org creation.
    - Fixed an issue where the Activity Timeline component was not supported on the Work Order object
        in Lightning communities. The Work Order object now displays the Activity Timeline, allowing users
•       to see New Task and New Event actions as expected.
   Managed Package (258.5 and 258.6)
    - Fixed an issue where scheduling failed because a service appointment slot was taken by another
        service appointment.
    - Fixed an issue where a Null Pointer Exception occurred in the RSOPreProcessor class when running
        Resource Scheduling Optimization (RSO) jobs with a custom boolean field instead of explicit service
        appointment IDs.
    - Fixed an issue where repeated calls to addTerritoryAttributesToResource caused performance
        degradation due to inefficient runtime complexity.
    - Fixed an issue where a resource absence disappeared from the Gantt chart when the resource’s

Handle Service Resource Absences Automatically

Reduce dispatcher overhead and minimize service disruptions when mobile workers are unavailable.
Mobile workers can now report absences for the current day directly with Agentforce via Slack or the
Field Service mobile app. Agentforce then logs the absence on the Gantt and reassigns their
appointments to available workers. For appointments that can’t be reassigned, Agentforce reaches out to
the customers to find the next suitable time—keeping your field operations running smoothly.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, Einstein 1,
Agentforce 1 for Field Service, and Developer Editions with any Field Service license and access to
Agentforce Service agents.

How: In Setup, create two flows—one to create the resource absence and another to reschedule
appointments. Define an agent topic and agent actions that reference your flows. Then, create and
configure your agent to include the new topic and actions, enabling it to manage absences via Slack and
the Field Service mobile app.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Example: Handle Service Resource Absences

Send Customers an Automated Email Confirming Their Scheduling Agent
Request

Automate a confirmation email to notify customers that their Agentforce request was successful. This
timely communication improves customer experience and gives clear visibility into the outcome of
customer requests.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, Einstein 1,
Agentforce 1 for Field Service, and Developer editions with any Field Service license and access to
Agentforce Service agents.



    519

Salesforce Release Notes Field Service

How: Create an agent from the Scheduling or Agentforce Service Agent templates to get the latest
version of the Appointment Management for Field Service topic. The flows referenced by the topic’s
actions now include a subflow that automatically sends a confirmation email to the customer. In the
Field Service: Send Confirmation to Customer flow, open the sendEmail variable and change the default
value to True.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Configure Autonomous Scheduling

Streamline Pre-Work Brief with Rich Text

Boost mobile worker productivity by transforming Pre-Work Brief from plain text into a rich resource. You
can now use Markdown formatting to create content that is easier to read and structure, significantly
improving clarity for complex instructions. Additionally, this update supports embedded hyperlinks,
allowing mobile workers to access external resources, like collaboration channels and visual aids, without
leaving their workflow.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions,
and in the Field Service mobile app for Android and iOS.

How: Configure briefs in Prompt Builder or Flow Builder by utilizing Markdown syntax to organize
content with structural elements like paragraphs, bold or italicized text, and lists. The update also
supports the insertion of clickable URLs that open directly in the device’s default browser or specific
applications, ensuring mobile workers have immediate access to the data they need.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Set Up Pre-Work Brief for Field Service Mobile Workers

content easier to consume and enhancing overall accessibility. The updated voice technology replaces
robotic tones with more natural speech patterns, improving clarity and making hands-free data entry
more effective.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions,

  seeing unrelated information.

Enable Private Mobile App Sharing in Visual Remote Assistant (VRA)
Sessions

Customers can now share an application window from their mobile device during VRA sessions, keeping
the rest of their device screen private. Call center reps see only the relevant content. Privacy provides
them with a secure and focused way to troubleshoot or review app-specific issues without seeing
unrelated information.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions
with the Field Service managed package and Visual Remote Assistant installed. Application sharing is
supported on Android and iOS, depending on OS capabilities.

How: Go to the Invite Page and select the Application Sharing mode. During a session, customers are
prompted to select an app window to share. Only that window is visible to the call center rep.

Streamline Image Management by Retrieving Multiple Visual Remote
Assistant (VRA) Images

Efficiently capture multiple VRA session images at once and store them directly in Salesforce with the
VRA Mass Image Retrieval screen flow. Centralizing these images on related records ensures easy access
to historical session images for review and follow-up.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience for Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions
with the Field Service managed package and Visual Remote Assistant installed.

How: Run the VRA Mass Image Retrieval screen flow, select a reference record, and define a session date
range. The flow triggers a custom process that retrieves the selected images from secure cloud storage,
saves these images as Salesforce files, and automatically links them to the session record for easy bulk
management.

  preview thumbnails, zoom in on details, and swipe through a full-screen carousel of site photos.

Accelerate Data Entry and Improve Form Accuracy with the Data Capture Lookup
Component

Help mobile workers find the exact records they need—like assets or products—by searching and selecting
records directly in the Data Capture form, even when offline. With the new Lookup component, they can
search by name or by any object field. Previously, mobile workers had to manually enter text fields, which
was tedious, slow, and error-prone.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions,
and in the Field Service mobile app for Android and iOS .

two fields to search by.

Enhance Productivity by Previewing Multiple Images in Data Capture Forms

Give your mobile workers complete visual context for improved performance by displaying multiple
related images directly within the Data Capture form, even when offline. The new Multiple Image
Preview component can link to a record and access all images associated with it. Mobile workers can
review images from previous jobs, and add images to the record after the form is created. They can
preview thumbnails, zoom in on details, and swipe through a full-screen carousel of site photos.
Previously, mobile workers could only view a single image that had to be uploaded when the form was
created.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions,
and in the Field Service mobile app for Android and iOS .

How: In Flow Builder, add the Multiple Image Preview component to a screen and configure it to display
images by linking to a record, such as a work order. You can define the maximum number of thumbnails
to display. To enable offline viewing, make sure that the related records and images are primed using
Briefcase Builder. The form must be loaded at least once while online, and all images must be loaded
before the images can be accessed offline.

  Benefit from advanced features and better schedule quality with Enhanced Scheduling and
  Optimization.

  Get near real-time updates when working with the dispatcher console Gantt by enabling the new
  Enhanced Live Updates setting. This setting’s enhanced capabilities significantly reduce the Gantt’s
  refresh times, dropping from 15–20 seconds to under 3 seconds. It lets you handle large datasets

  With this new setting, Experience Cloud site users can also benefit from live Gantt updates. Previously,

  travel time estimations that better reflect real-world traffic patterns. Field Service Maps data for EU

Enhanced Scheduling and Optimization

Benefit from advanced features and better schedule quality with Enhanced Scheduling and
Optimization.

  Optimize Large Datasets in One Smooth Operation with Dynamic Scaling (Generally Available)
  Set up and manage large-scale global and in-day optimization effectively without splitting data due to
  system limits. Dynamic scaling intelligently structures data into geographical clusters, seamlessly
  balancing demand and capacity while accounting for all operational work rule constraints. This
  capability simplifies optimization management by enabling higher system limits, so you don’t need to
  manually define optimization groups and boundaries. It also prevents conflicts and overlaps that often
  occur with fragmented, parallel optimization runs. You can now easily select all service territories when
  you configure a scheduled optimization job without having to select each territory individually.
  Previously, you had to define boundaries between areas that needed to be optimized together, making
  workforce planning difficult. Lower system limits meant you had to reduce the number of service


    534

Salesforce Release Notes Field Service

  appointments or service resources processed in a single request, and configure multiple optimization
  jobs. This fragmentation was tedious and affected overall business performance.
  Get More Optimal Scheduling with Updated Service Objective Scoring Formulas
  Achieve improved scheduling outcomes that match your business priorities with refined grading
  formulas that better reflect your configured service objective weights. The impact of the Skill
  Preference and Skill Level objectives has doubled. And, the Resource Priority objective now relies on a
  fixed scale of 1 to 10 instead of the priority values sent in each optimization request, so that the
  schedule outcome is more predictable. Previously, some underlying calculations reduced the intended
  impact of an objective's assigned weight.
  Access Optimization Request Files on Your Own (Generally Available)
  Use Optimization Request Files to retrieve the request and response files of an optimization request.
  Review the files in a JSON format to find out what happened to a specific request and quickly resolve
  related issues. Previously, you had to open a Support case and wait to get the files, which delayed the
  troubleshooting process.
  Get More Transparency into Service Operation Inefficiencies with Rule Violation Analytics (Beta)
  Understand the root causes of rule violations in manual scheduling, such as geographical imbalances
  or skill gaps, and make data-driven decisions by analyzing trends and patterns. Rule Violation
  Analytics, built on the Enhanced Scheduling and Optimization Data Model, captures all rules that are
  manually violated on the Gantt. Easily query this data via a semantic data model and draw insights by
  creating a comprehensive dashboard in Tableau Next. Visualize rule violations, track metrics like the
  frequency of specific rule violations, and identify dispatchers or territories with recurring issues.
  Proactively address inefficiencies for better resource allocation, workforce planning, and dispatcher
  training.

Optimize Large Datasets in One Smooth Operation with Dynamic Scaling (Generally
Available)

Set up and manage large-scale global and in-day optimization effectively without splitting data due to
system limits. Dynamic scaling intelligently structures data into geographical clusters, seamlessly
balancing demand and capacity while accounting for all operational work rule constraints. This capability
simplifies optimization management by enabling higher system limits, so you don’t need to manually
define optimization groups and boundaries. It also prevents conflicts and overlaps that often occur with
fragmented, parallel optimization runs. You can now easily select all service territories when you
configure a scheduled optimization job without having to select each territory individually. Previously,
you had to define boundaries between areas that needed to be optimized together, making workforce
planning difficult. Lower system limits meant you had to reduce the number of service appointments or
service resources processed in a single request, and configure multiple optimization jobs. This
fragmentation was tedious and affected overall business performance.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience and Salesforce Classic in Enterprise, Unlimited,
and Developer editions with the Field Service managed package installed.

How: In Setup, go to Field Service Settings and verify that Field Service Enhanced Scheduling and
Optimization is enabled. In the Field Service Admin app, go to Field Service Settings. Select



    535

Salesforce Release Notes Field Service

Optimization, and then, in the Logic tab, select Enable Dynamic Scaling. Then select the Scheduled
Jobs tab. For any job, you can select all service territories to be optimized in one group.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Set Up Optimization of Large Field Service Datasets with Dynamic Scaling

Get More Optimal Scheduling with Updated Service Objective Scoring Formulas

Achieve improved scheduling outcomes that match your business priorities with refined grading
formulas that better reflect your configured service objective weights. The impact of the Skill Preference
and Skill Level objectives has doubled. And, the Resource Priority objective now relies on a fixed scale of
1 to 10 instead of the priority values sent in each optimization request, so that the schedule outcome is
more predictable. Previously, some underlying calculations reduced the intended impact of an
objective's assigned weight.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience and Salesforce Classic in Enterprise, Unlimited, and
Developer editions with the Field Service managed package installed.

How: To opt out of this update and continue using the previous formulas, contact Salesforce Customer
Support.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Create and Manage Field Service Objectives

Access Optimization Request Files on Your Own (Generally Available)

Use Optimization Request Files to retrieve the request and response files of an optimization request.
Review the files in a JSON format to find out what happened to a specific request and quickly resolve
related issues. Previously, you had to open a Support case and wait to get the files, which delayed the
troubleshooting process.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions
with the Field Service managed package installed.

How: In Setup, go to Field Service Settings and verify that Field Service Enhanced Scheduling and
Optimization is enabled. In the Field Service Admin app, click the Field Service Settings tab and select
Scheduling. Then, enable optimization request files under General Logic. To access optimization request
files, from the App Launcher, find and select Optimization Center.

Get More Precise Travel Time Calculations with Upgraded EU Maps Data

Improve schedule efficiency and reliability with enhanced Maps data for more accurate routing and
travel time estimations that better reflect real-world traffic patterns. Field Service Maps data for EU
customers now incorporates travel speed fluctuations throughout the day. With travel times typically
increasing during peak periods, this granular update ensures your schedule is grounded in reality,
reducing late arrivals and providing a more stable day of service.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions
with the Field Service managed package installed.

When: This update rolls out starting February 12, 2026. Completion is expected within 24 hours but
may take up to 48 hours.

Why: To improve routing accuracy, the map data repository now accounts for variable travel speeds, such
as during rush hour, which can increase travel time estimates on average by up to 10%. While most
travel times increase, some specific routes can show decreased travel times compared to previous
averages due to more granular data.

How: This update is automatically applied to organizations using Point-to-Point Predictive Routing in the
EU. Travel calculations for service appointments already on your schedule can change, creating overlaps,
rule violations, or brief periods of idle time. To resolve these conflicts, use a fix overlaps feature, or run
Global, In-Day, or Resource Optimization.

Hyperforce

Products and features from Data 360, Marketing Cloud, Platform, MuleSoft, and Tableau Cloud are now
available in more Hyperforce regions. Hyperforce Assistant introduced a new way to find hard-coded
references. The Hyperforce public IP ranges now include addresses for inbound connections, in addition
to existing outbound addresses. Prepare for IPv6 if you use IP allowlists.

  Access Salesforce in More Regions with Hyperforce
  Hyperforce is available in 17 countries, giving you more choice and control over data residency.
  Find Hard-Coded References Using the Updated Hyperforce Assistant Process
  The automated check previously available in step one of Hyperforce Assistant has been replaced due
  to updates in underlying tools. The remaining Hyperforce Assistant features remain unchanged.
  Hyperforce Assistant helps customers prepare their org for migration. Because your org’s instance
  changes during migration, hard-coded references cause functionality failures post-migration. Finding
  and resolving hard-coded references during the preparation phase enables applications to maintain
  correct functionality after the upgrade to Hyperforce.
  Hyperforce Public IP Ranges Now Include Inbound Addresses
  The Hyperforce public IP address ranges have been expanded to include inbound addresses for traffic
  to your Salesforce org. Previously, these ranges contained IP addresses only for connections from
  Salesforce to the customer network. Now, these ranges also contain IP addresses for inbound
  connections to your Salesforce org. Salesforce recommends adopting modern security practices, such
  as mTLS, instead of allowlisting on Hyperforce. But for customers with an insurmountable business or
  compliance requirement to use allowlists, Salesforce provides Hyperforce public IP ranges in JSON
  format.
  Prepare for IPv6 in Hyperforce Public IPs
  If you use an IP allowlist to restrict network traffic or you restrict access to Salesforce via IP address,
  prepare to update your allowlists to include IPv6 addresses.
  Scan Files for Malware (Beta)
  For improved security in your Salesforce org, files are now scanned for malware in Salesforce Files.
  Most new files are scanned when they’re uploaded to an org, and most existing files are scanned when
  they’re downloaded from an org.

Find Hard-Coded References Using the Updated Hyperforce
Assistant Process

The automated check previously available in step one of Hyperforce Assistant has been replaced due to
updates in underlying tools. The remaining Hyperforce Assistant features remain unchanged. Hyperforce
Assistant helps customers prepare their org for migration. Because your org’s instance changes during
migration, hard-coded references cause functionality failures post-migration. Finding and resolving hard-
coded references during the preparation phase enables applications to maintain correct functionality



                 541

Salesforce Release Notes Hyperforce

after the upgrade to Hyperforce.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in all editions.

How: To check for hard-coded references and prepare your org for Hyperforce migration, install and run
the Salesforce Labs Org Check package. The Hyperforce Assistant guides you to the external package. If
your needs aren’t met by Org Check, log a support case.

Hyperforce Public IP Ranges Now Include Inbound Addresses

The Hyperforce public IP address ranges have been expanded to include inbound addresses for traffic to
your Salesforce org. Previously, these ranges contained IP addresses only for connections from Salesforce
to the customer network. Now, these ranges also contain IP addresses for inbound connections to your
Salesforce org. Salesforce recommends adopting modern security practices, such as mTLS, instead of
allowlisting on Hyperforce. But for customers with an insurmountable business or compliance
requirement to use allowlists, Salesforce provides Hyperforce public IP ranges in JSON format.

Where: This change applies to all Salesforce orgs that manage connectivity using IP allowlists, including
those on Hyperforce and on first-party infrastructure. These ranges support products built on the
Salesforce platform, including Sales, Service, and Industries clouds, as well as Tableau and the MuleSoft
Anypoint Platform. These addresses are not for email, and not for Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, or
Slack.

How: Access the Hyperforce public IP address ranges at https://ip-ranges.salesforce.com/ip-
ranges.json.

See Also
  Knowledge Article: Hyperforce IPs to Allow - Sales, Service, Industries, and Tableau Clouds

Prepare for IPv6 in Hyperforce Public IPs

If you use an IP allowlist to restrict network traffic or you restrict access to Salesforce via IP address,
prepare to update your allowlists to include IPv6 addresses.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience and Salesforce Classic in all editions.

  Get Ready for IPv6

Inventory Management Enhancements

Enhance operational efficiency with new capabilities that streamline inventory management.

  Improve Order Fulfillment Accuracy with Inventory Allocation
  Manage inventory allocation for sales orders and work orders across multiple locations with accurate,
  real-time visibility. View stock statuses, such as on-hand, allocated, and available, and soft-reserve
  inventory for specific orders. Assign inventory to orders to prevent overcommitment and maintain
  accurate inventory visibility, even during high-volume, concurrent transactions. This helps prevent
  stock conflicts, improves tracking accuracy, and supports smarter, more efficient fulfillment decisions.
  Streamline Inventory Counting Across Locations
  Easily manage inventory counts across hierarchical structures, such as warehouses or service fleets,
  without creating separate plans for each room, aisle, or field service vehicle. Using the Location
  Hierarchy, you can easily define parent and child locations, so selecting a parent location in a plan
  automatically displays all its associated child locations. Inventory managers can then select child
  locations and bulk add or choose product items to create a single, comprehensive inventory count
  plan.
  New and Changed Objects for Inventory Management
  Do more with the new and updated objects for Inventory Management.

Improve Order Fulfillment Accuracy with Inventory Allocation

Manage inventory allocation for sales orders and work orders across multiple locations with accurate,
real-time visibility. View stock statuses, such as on-hand, allocated, and available, and soft-reserve
inventory for specific orders. Assign inventory to orders to prevent overcommitment and maintain
accurate inventory visibility, even during high-volume, concurrent transactions. This helps prevent stock
conflicts, improves tracking accuracy, and supports smarter, more efficient fulfillment decisions.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience for Automotive, Communications, Energy and
Utilities, Manufacturing, and Media, where Asset Service Lifecycle Management is enabled.

Who: This feature is available to users with the Inventory Allocation and Inventory Search and Transfer
permission sets.

Why: Tracking only the total on-hand quantity is often insufficient and can lead to over-promising and
inaccurate order fulfillment. Allocating inventory with full visibility into inventory statuses allows you to
clearly identify which portion of stock is truly available for new orders and which portion is already soft-
reserved for existing commitments. This improves order fulfillment accuracy and supports more reliable
operations.

How: Add the Inventory Allocation component to the Order and Work Order pages to view and create
allocations for products available as line items.

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

Easily manage inventory counts across hierarchical structures, such as warehouses or service fleets,
without creating separate plans for each room, aisle, or field service vehicle. Using the Location
Hierarchy, you can easily define parent and child locations, so selecting a parent location in a plan
automatically displays all its associated child locations. Inventory managers can then select child
locations and bulk add or choose product items to create a single, comprehensive inventory count plan.

permission sets.

Changed Objects

Store the quantity of product items that are allocated but not yet shipped.
        Use the new field Quantity Allocated on Product Item.

Store the quantity of product items that are currently available in inventory.
        Use the new field Quantity Available on Product Item.

Store the date and time when the quantity status of the product item was last updated.
        Use the new field Quantity State Refresh Date on Product Item.

    Represent the production batch details for a product campaign definition item.
    Use the new Inventory Reservation object.

    Represent inventory item reservation information for a specific product and location.
    Use the new Inventory Item Reservation object.

    Represent an individual transaction that records a change in the state and quantity of a specific
    product item.
    Use the new Product Item Additional Transaction object.

Enterprise Sales Management

Improve quote clarity and workflow efficiency with new controls. Manage larger orders and link cloned
quotes directly to opportunities. Protect your data by retaining original pricing and confirming line item
deletions.

  Associate Cloned Quotes with New or Existing Opportunities
  Associate a cloned quote with a different existing opportunity or a newly created one directly within
  the cloning workflow and eliminate manual re-association steps for your sales team. Previously, sales
  reps had to clone a quote and then manually re-associate it with the correct opportunity in a separate
  step. Consolidating these actions streamlines the sales process and reduces data entry errors.
  Retain Original Asset Pricing During Modifications
  Preserve original asset prices during Move, Add, Change, Delete (MACD) operations in Enterprise Sales
  Management by defining attributes in Industries CPQ. Now, pricing calculations run only when you
  modify a price-impacting attribute, such as a manual override, applied discount, or quantity change.
  Updates to non-price attributes no longer trigger automatic repricing. Industries CPQ identifies these
  attributes via attribute-based pricing. This feature requires Standard Cart APIs to be enabled.
  Prevent Unnecessary Action Status Updates During MACD Operations
  Preserve the Existing status on asset line items when Move, Add, Change, Delete (MACD) rules update
  attribute properties without altering the actual values. Industries CPQ compares the original and
  current values so that only actual data modifications trigger a Change status. Previously, both value
  modifications and metadata changes triggered a status update to Change. This feature requires
  Standard Cart APIs to be enabled.
  Accelerate Sub-Order Creation with Scaled Batch Sizes
  Streamline your quote-to-order process by using scaled batch sizes to generate sub-orders faster within
  Enterprise Sales Management. Enable your sales reps to convert high-volume quotes efficiently while
  maintaining system stability and staying within query limits.
  Confirm Deletion of Quote Line Items in the Summary Tab
  The Summary tab prompts for confirmation when you delete a Quote Line Item in an Enterprise Sales
  quote. This step prevents accidental removal and confirms that the deletion is intentional.


    567

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

  View Placeholders for Hidden Attributes in Enterprise Sales Quotes
  Get immediate context regarding attribute visibility in the Enterprise Sales Quote interface. When
  catalog configuration rules hide attributes, a placeholder UI label now appears rather than the fields
  disappearing. This UI label helps sales reps focus on customer-relevant data during the quoting
  process.
  Process Large Enterprise Quotes with Enhanced Stability
  Manage your large enterprise deals with a robust, optimized processing engine. Your sales reps can
  execute bulk Move, Add, Change, Delete (MACD) operations without timeouts or system instability.
  High-volume datasets previously caused transaction failures and governor limit errors, leading to
  breakdowns in the quoting workflow.

New Connect REST APIs for Consumer Sales

Use the new resources available with Consumer Sales to address your business requirements.

Get a list of products for a specified catalog, category, or subcategory.
  Make a POST request to the /connect/consumer/products resource.

  New request body: ProductListInput

  New response body: ProductListOutput



  576

Salesforce Release Notes    Industries


Get product details, such as attributes, hierarchy, or cardinality, for a specified product ID.
 Make a POST request to the /connect/consumer/products/${productId} resource.

 New request body: ProductDetailsInput

 New response body: ProductBaseDetailsOutput

Retrieve details for multiple products.
 Make a POST request to the /connect/consumer/products/bulk resource.

 New request body: BulkProductSpecificationsInput

 New response body: BulkProductSpecificationsOutput

Retrieve and update a product’s configuration from a configurator.
 Make a POST request to the /connect/consumer/configure resource.

 New request body: ProductConfigurationInput

 New response body: ProductConfigurationOutput

Create a sales transaction, such as an order or a quote, with integrated pricing and configuration.
 Make a POST request to the /connect/consumer/place resource.

 New request body: PlaceSalesTransactionInput

 New response body: PlaceSalesTransactionOutput

Create single order for all items present in the cart.
 Make a POST request to the /connect/consumer/checkout resource.

 New request body: CreateOrderFromCartInput

 New response body: CreateOrderFromCartOutput

Visual Studio Code Based Modeler

Create detailed, well-formatted documents with improved readability and flexibility of PDF previews and
printed documents for your users. Define custom page dimensions and configure correct date formats to
ensure that documents are tailored to specific business needs and global audiences.

  Customize Page Dimensions and Styles in Print Layout
  Design custom page dimensions and override default formatting by using the styles node. The style
  designed for a paragraph applies to all paragraph elements in the print layout. You can set the style
  name to paragraph, table, tand headings. Specifying attributes such as font size, margin, bold, and
  italics is optional.
  Other Improvements in Visual Studio Code Based Modeler
  The PDF preview now automatically splits content pages, improving readability without affecting
  thermal printing. Adapt page layout rules to append more columns and apply center alignment.
  Configure day and year values in correct formats for all supported languages.

Customize Page Dimensions and Styles in Print Layout

Design custom page dimensions and override default formatting by using the styles node. The style
designed for a paragraph applies to all paragraph elements in the print layout. You can set the style name
to paragraph, table, tand headings. Specifying attributes such as font size, margin, bold, and italics is
optional.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, Einstein 1, and Agentforce
1 editions with Consumer Goods Cloud.



    584

Salesforce Release Notes        Industries

How: Adapt PrintLayout V2 contracts with page dimensions or custom sizes with these standard formats
- A4 (default), A5, EXECUTIVE, FOLIO, LEGAL, LETTER, and TABLOID. You can now define pageSize with
an array of width and height in points, where 1 inch = 72 points. For example, pageSize="[216,
auto]" .

Customize or modify the default formatting in your print layouts with the styles node.

 ...
 <ReportLayout pageMargins="[5,5,5,5]" pageSize="[216, auto]">
    <styles>
        <style name="paragraph" fontSize="12" bold="true" />
        <style name="tableBody" margin="[0,2,0,2]" italics="true" />
    </styles>
 ...

The styles node configuration isn’t supported for Bluetooth thermal printers.

Other Improvements in Visual Studio Code Based Modeler

The PDF preview now automatically splits content pages, improving readability without affecting thermal
printing. Adapt page layout rules to append more columns and apply center alignment. Configure day
and year values in correct formats for all supported languages.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise and Unlimited editions with Consumer
Goods Cloud.

Why: Visual Studio Code Based Modeler offers these enhancements.

• PDF preview readability with auto-spilt pages: Content is now automatically split into pages in the
   preview. Previously, all content appeared on a single page when the PDF height was set to auto for
   3-inch Bluetooth thermal printers. This change makes it easier to read in the preview without affecting
   the actual thermal printing. See Considerations and Guidelines for Bluetooth Thermal Printer and Print
• Layout Setup.
   Page layout rules and text alignment: Add more columns to your 3-inch PDF prints to create detailed
   and readable documents. You can set the minimum width requirement for <th> elements in the
   print layout upto 8%. You can also center align <th> elements. See Considerations and Guidelines
   for Bluetooth Thermal Printer and Print Layout Setup.

Trade Promotion Management

Get better visibility of financial metrics throughout promotion planning and execution phases by writing
back accrual amounts into tactic funds. Enhance engine capabilities by supporting accrual calculations
for tiered tactics and growth programs. Help centralize data for advanced sales and promotion analysis
by integrating Trade Promotion Management data with Data 360.

  Get Accrual Data Directly in Tactic Funds
  Configure the write-back of accrual amounts into tactic funds. The aggregated accrual output is
  updated in the tactic fund to inform the key account manager of what the current accrued liabilities
  and other financial metrics are.
  Get Accurate Financials for Tier Tactics and Growth Programs
  Key account managers (KAMs) can calculate accruals for tier tactics and growth programs. Accrual
  calculations for tier tactics provide KAMs with an accurate picture of liabilities throughout the entire
  promotional lifecycle.
  Integrate Trade Promotion Management Data with Data 360 for Enhanced Insights
  Enhance visibility into Trade Promotion Management (TPM) writeback KPIs in Data 360 by centralizing

Changed APIs in Trade Promotion Management

Do more with the changed APIs in v66 and later.

Value of ID in Delete Promotion or Tactic APIs

 When sending a request to a Delete Promotion or Tactic API, the value of the ID parameter must
 be only a number.

Date Validation Enhancement

 A validation error with a 400 status code is returned if an API request includes an incorrect date
 in the payload.

Education

Learn about the latest features from Agentforce Education, formerly Education Cloud, that boost
productivity throughout your organization. Support recruitment, admissions, academic operations,
student success, advancement, and alumni engagement with the latest CRM and student information
system (SIS) capabilities.

     Note Education Cloud is now Agentforce Education. You may see references to Education Cloud in
     our application and documentation.

  Agentforce for Education
  Streamline student financial management, offer autonomous transfer credit estimates, strengthen
  prospect research strategy, and centralize course collaboration within Slack.
  Streamline Transfer Credit Evaluations for Students
  Create and manage transfer equivalency relationships and the entire transfer credit process from a
  unified interface that automatically matches and suggests credits. Registrars can use the guided
  process to review submitted documentation and to articulate credit transfer requests.
  Accelerate Transfer Credit Evaluations in the Application Process
  Speed up learning equivalency evaluations and reduce student wait time by requesting estimates for
  transferable credits directly in the application portal. Applicants can enter details of prior learning and
  upload supporting documents and images in each admissions application. They can also reuse
  previous estimates to prefill and create official transfer credit requests. When an applicant submits
  their information, automatically create records and streamline the review process.
  Help Students Register for High-Demand Courses Efficiently
  Configure course waitlists to simplify the enrollment process and manage the demand for popular
  courses. Support students to join the waitlists of high-demand courses directly from the Experience
  Cloud site and notify them when seats open up, reducing the stress of monitoring course availability.
  Determine student enrollment priority and timing on a dedicated setup page. Send enrollment offers
  to students by using prebuilt flows. Students can accept or decline an offer to enroll, or remove
  themselves from waitlists.
  Configure Educational Characteristics to Enforce Eligibility Checks During Course Registration
  Clearly communicate eligibility criteria to students during course registration. Configure complex
  eligibility logic on learning courses by using a flexible and scalable framework. Define and assign
  identity-based attributes to students, such as major, cohort, or honors status, that tie to specific time
  frames. Automatically evaluate student attributes against eligibility criteria to enforce enrollment rules.
  Show students the required educational characteristics of each course to help them make informed
  decisions. Maintain accurate enrollment data and comply with institutional policies.
  Simplify Appointment Scheduling Setup in Agentforce Education
  System administrators get clear guidance at every stage to quickly set up appointment scheduling
  topics, assign staff, and complete all prerequisite steps. This feature drastically cuts down on
  configuration time and reduces errors. Staff members now have a simplified experience to manage
  their own and their colleagues’ availability with a few clicks. Institutions can configure scheduling
  quickly and accurately by using intuitive guidance and education-aligned language.

Use the Agentforce Banking Service Customer Assistance agent template to create agents that serve your
banking customers across multiple channels. Resolve inquiries faster by connecting with customers on
voice, WhatsApp, and third-party websites.

  Transform Digital Customer Experience with Agentforce Banking Service Customer Assistance
  Support your customers with an AI-powered self-service that autonomously creates cases for banking
  inquiries and helps them with their queries. The agent securely verifies customer identity to access
  sensitive account information. This integrated verification helps customers complete tasks without
  switching screens. For complex service requests, the agent conversationally escalates the interaction to
  live service representatives with full context.

  Your customers can securely raise requests for banking services on WhatsApp. Route banking

  Use a prebuilt flow to route banking service inquiries from third-party websites or your bank's secure

  securely manage interactions for guest users, recognize logged-in users, and initiate customer

  Components, the agent can show financial accounts, balances, and transactions more clearly in the
  Agentforce Banking Service Employee Assistance console and Banking Service Customer Assistance
  chat interface.

Why: Use the prebuilt agent topics included in the Banking Service Customer Assistance template.

• Address Update Request: Helps customers update their account-related and financial account-related
   addresses. Identifies and selects the specific address to change, gathers the new details, and creates a
• case for the update.
   Financial Account Statement Request: Helps customers request copies of checking or savings account
   statements. Collects details regarding the specific account, statement period, and delivery method,
• and creates a case for fulfillment.
   Financial Account Balances Request: Helps customers view the financial account balances associated
   with a specific account. Identifies the relevant financial account, and provides current details such as
• available and total balances.
   Financial Account Transactions Request: Helps customers identify the relevant account, and shows the
• history including deposits, withdrawals, and payments.
   Card Lock Management Request: Captures customers requests to lock or freeze a card temporarily or
• to unlock or reactivate a previously locked card.
   Funds Transfer to Own Account Request: Helps customers set up one-time or recurring fund transfers
   between savings and deposit accounts, including loan and credit card payments. Collects necessary
• payment details, and creates a case for the fund transfer.
   Report Credit or Debit Card Request: Helps customers report their credit or debit card as lost, stolen,
   destroyed, or captured by an ATM. Shows the necessary card details, and creates a case to block the
• card to prevent unauthorized use.
   Fee Reversal Request (beta): Helps customers reverse the fees charged to their financial accounts.
   Assists in identifying the specific transaction to reverse by showing relevant details, and submits the
   reversal request for processing.

and select Autosave Assessmment Progress under Save Options in the properties panel.

versioning. Manage the end-to-end agency billing workflow with greater accuracy, automation, and
financial control. Boost sales efficiency with unified multi-root quoting. Help users compare insurance
products side by side and select an optimal plan. Apply policy limits over more flexible durations,

  Use Digital Insurance Alongside the Insurance Managed Package or Insurance CRM
  Launch new products faster on the flexible Digital Insurance platform while you manage existing
  products, policies, and claims in the same org. Eliminate the overhead of administering separate orgs
  or rebuilding custom integrations extensively. Manage products, quotes, policies, and claims using
  solution-specific workflows and keep the transactional data, metadata, and automations segregated
  based on the originating solution. Although Digital Insurance can coexist with Insurance CRM or the


    643

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

  Insurance managed package, these solutions don't interoperate.
  Accelerate Sales with Unified Multi-Root Insurance Quoting
  Create a single, comprehensive quote that includes multiple root products, such as Auto and Home.
  Captive agents can configure and price several products together and present them as a single
  offering. All lifecycle operations are managed at the parent policy level, and premiums and taxes
  aggregate from each child policy to deliver a consolidated financial overview. Use the multi-root
  issuance API (or invocable action) to create the parent and child policies upon quote acceptance.
  Manage subsequent renewals and endorsements at the parent policy level using the corresponding
  multi-root APIs or invocable actions.
  Agency Billing
  Manage the end-to-end agency billing workflow with greater accuracy, automation, and financial
  control across invoicing, payments, journals, and collections.
  Enable Comparative Rating and Multiple Plan Selection
  The Product Selection Lightning Web Component for Omnistudio allows end users to effortlessly
  compare multiple rated insurance products and choose the optimal plan directly within a guided
  Omniscript flow. Quickly compare up to three different root products side-by-side to understand
  variations in coverages and pricing. This component passes multiple rating inputs to the Insurance
  Rating API, which rates several root products and returns the calculated premiums and details. The UI
  displays product cards showing the premium and taxes for each option.
  Validate Complex Configurations with Constraint Rules Engine
  With Constraint Rules Engine (CRE), use constraint-based logic to validate complex product
  configurations. This feature supports deeply nested bundles, cross-product dependencies, and multi-
  instance insurance scenarios. CRE ensures accurate quoting by preventing invalid selections while you
  transition from Business Rules Engine to a constraint-driven model. For Insurance, Constraint Rules
  Engine is currently only supported for exclusions, clauses and configuration rules.
  Simplify Quoting and Policy Configuration through Guided Flows
  With the Product Configuration Lightning Web Component, users can immediately see how policy
  attribute changes affect the premium, enabling efficient, real-time quote generation. This component
  for Omnistudio accepts multiple rating inputs and calls the Insurance Rating POST and PATCH APIs to
  update attribute values for specific coverages.
  Track Policy Limits with Flexible Duration Types
  Reset policy limits at the end of a calendar year or on a specific override date, or enforce lifetime limits
  that don’t reset. Previously, you could only reset limits at the end of a policy term.
  Cap Payments at the Lowest Limit for Loss Claims
  Adjusters can now determine the correct payable amount without manual calculations before they
  request approvals. Enforce the lowest remaining limit, and track consumption across sub-coverage,
  coverage, and policy levels for loss-type payments. Prevent failed payments, recalculations, and messy
  audit trails.
  Revise Claim Coverage Payment Details to Make Corrections
  Edit details such as the payee or the claim amount for a claim coverage payment. Calculate the new
  adjusted amount and update the limit tracking for accurate audit trails. Previously, you deleted a claim
  coverage payment detail record and created a new one to update details.
  Issue Ex Gratia Payments for Loss Claims


    644

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

  Authorize exceptional payments for loss claims that exceed the policy or coverage limits. Track ex
  gratia payments for auditability while capping consumption at the remaining limit. Handle special
  circumstances and maintain positive customer relations without manual workarounds or negative
  balances.
  Copy Data Between Nodes in a Pricing Procedure
  Gather the required data for price calculations by copying attributes to a node from its parent, child, or
  other related nodes. Previously, you could only aggregate numerical attributes from related nodes as a
  workaround but couldn’t access the text attributes. For example, when calculating the premium for
  collision coverage, add attributes from the product, vehicle, and driver nodes to the coverage node to
  compile the data for the calculation.

Copy Data Between Nodes in a Pricing Procedure

Gather the required data for price calculations by copying attributes to a node from its parent, child, or
other related nodes. Previously, you could only aggregate numerical attributes from related nodes as a
workaround but couldn’t access the text attributes. For example, when calculating the premium for
collision coverage, add attributes from the product, vehicle, and driver nodes to the coverage node to
compile the data for the calculation.

with Digital Insurance where Digital Insurance Product Administration and Salesforce Pricing are
enabled.

  Filter Admin Console Tiles Based on User Permissions
  Show users only the tiles they need in the Admin Console by turning on Filter Admin Console Tiles
  Based On User Permissions. Use Life Sciences Customer Engagement Setup to make the change.

  Streamline mobile workflows with a custom list view designed for speed. The Actionable List View
  embeds configurable quick actions directly into the visit list card. Field representatives can perform
  routine tasks, such as sample drops and detailing, without clicking into the full record. With GoTo
  navigation that deep-links to specific sidebars within the Visit Engagement page, users spend less time
  navigating menus and can focus on completing tasks.
  Signature Page Screen Snapshot
  Ensure total audit readiness with a robust compliance enhancement that captures the exact context of
  an acknowledgement by a Health Care Provider (HCP). The Signature Page Snapshot automatically
  captures an image of the signature screen, including sample products, disclaimer text, and scrolled
  areas at the moment of sign-off. The snapshot is automatically attached to the visit record, providing
  verifiable proof of what's signed. This feature secures audit trails even if system configurations or legal
  text change in the future.
  Manage Visits from the Service Console
  Sales reps can now multitask more efficiently with the integration of Visit Management directly into
  the Service Console. Instead of windows that cover the whole screen, Visit Engagement pages now
  open in subtabs so you can work on multiple records at once. High-volume users can now complete

Intelligent Content

Expand your search beyond just presentation names and metadata properties by searching within
presentation content. Share presentations with healthcare professionals as unique links instead of as
email attachments.

   Share Presentations as Unique Email Links


   673

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

   Maximize the impact of your content by enabling field users to send presentations as links in
   preapproved email templates. By using email links, healthcare professionals (HCPs) can view content
   in a dedicated portal without downloading email attachments. Manage when presentations are
   available so that HCPs always see the most up-to-date content, and maintain access controls by
   defining when links expire. Use rich engagement data—including pages viewed, time spent per page,
   and the HCP’s navigation path—to optimize presentations for future engagements.
   Use Smart Content Search to Find Relevant Presentations
   Improve the quality of your search results by using Data 360 to create a search index of the content in
   presentation files. While online, field users can search for presentations by using either keywords or
   conceptual terms and phrases, making it easier to find the most relevant materials. Previously, search
   results included only standard keyword-based matches on presentation names and metadata
   properties.

New and Enhanced Common Features for Manufacturing

Manufacturing includes access to some features that are available across clouds and products in
Industries. Use these features to extend and customize Manufacturing Cloud based on your business
needs.

• Action Launcher
   Make recommendations available in companion orgs to help teams quickly resolve customer issues.
• Deploy file-based data kits to configure Recommended Actions.
   Asset Service Lifecycle Management
   Quickly find and manage inventory with enhanced batch-level details and search capabilities,
   improving accuracy and streamlining your inventory processes. Timesheet and labor cost
   enhancements simplify time tracking, bulk entries, shift differential management, and error correction
• on mobile devices.
   Business Rule Engine
   Build more granular business-specific configurations by further categorizing Usage Types available in
   your Salesforce product into Usage Subtypes. Usage Subtype values are available to you depending on
   your industry solution and permission sets. Asynchronous processes in decision tables now create
• events when they are completed.
   Connected Assets
   Connect, monitor, and control assets in real time to drive smarter service operations. Define asset
   structures, collect telemetry data, trigger remote actions, and integrate with Digital Twin to optimize
• performance, reduce downtime, and enable proactive service delivery.
   Context Service
   Sort and filter data with context filters to retrieve precise and contextually relevant data with dynamic
   data filters in Context Service. Ensure continuous data flow across applications by modifying mappings
   without deactivating context definitions. The Time To Live (TTL) value of context instances created by
• Apex and flows is set to 10 seconds instead of 30 seconds.
   Data Processing Engine
   DPE now offers a debugging feature in beta for CRMA jobs, providing enhanced visibility into failures
   and outputs to empower users and reduce support reliance. Write back transformed data directly to
   data model objects (DMOs) using the Data Cloud runtime, with options to create DMOs and validate
   data types. Writeback nodes are updated to support upserting records with an External ID, improving
   data sync across different systems. Three new formula functions have been added to give you more
   control and flexibility in data transformation. The Data Cloud runtime now includes functionality such
   as composite and custom nodes, the ability to write back to new DLOs, and a debug mode for saving
   node output record counts.

  across large MSAs.
  Locate Products Faster with Improved Sales Agreement Filters
  Managing large volumes of products within Sales Agreements often requires users to narrow down
  information quickly and focus on specific products, schedules, or metrics. The enhanced filter
  capabilities make this easier by allowing users to apply multiple, precise conditions directly on the
  Sales Agreement data grid. Users can filter by product lines, schedules, and any field corresponding to
  Sales Agreement Product Schedules, including custom fields, to view only the data most relevant to
  their updates. This improvement supports faster navigation, more targeted updates, and greater
  efficiency when working with Sales Agreements.

Simplify Inventory Counting Across Parent and Child Locations

Perform inventory counts across hierarchical structures, such as warehouses or service fleets, without
creating separate plans for each room, aisle, or field service vehicle. Using the Location Hierarchy, you
can easily define parent and child locations, so selecting a parent location in a plan automatically


    686

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

displays all its associated child locations. Inventory managers can then select child locations and bulk
add or choose product items to create a single, comprehensive inventory count plan.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer editions
with Manufacturing enabled.

Who: This feature is available to users with the Inventory Count Manager and Inventory Count User
permission sets.

Why: Previously, an Inventory Manager had to create a separate inventory count plan for every location
where inventory was stored. For organizations with a high number of child locations such as a warehouse
with hundreds of rooms, this was time-consuming and error-prone. This enhancement reduces
administrative effort by allowing inventory managers to define a single, overarching plan at the parent
location.

clearly identify which portion of stock is truly available for new orders and which portion is already soft-

operations.

Enhance Search Experience with Criteria-Based Search and Filter

Criteria-Based Search and Filter (CBSF) now provides a more intuitive and reliable search experience with
consistent data display and clear visibility into when data was last updated. Date-time fields appear in the
user’s timezone using standard Salesforce formatting, and currency fields display symbols instead of
codes. Any Word Search is enabled by default in all orgs, and users can view the Last Refreshed Date for
search results, enhancing clarity and efficiency.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in all editions with Criteria-Based Search and Filter.

Who: This feature is available to users with the Criteria-Based Search and Filter system permission.

How: These changes are automatically applied to the CBSF user interface, including the use of local
timezone formatting for date-time fields (e.g., 10/25/2024, 2:36 PM) and currency symbols (e.g., $)
instead of currency codes.

For administrators, to enable the Last Refreshed Date display, link the searchable object configuration to
the Data Processing Engine (DPE) that populates the flat entity data. The date will then appear at the top
of the search results.

New and Changed Objects for Manufacturing

Manufacturing includes these new and changed objects.

New Objects

Represent information about the status of the inventory reservations.
    Use the new Inventory Reservation object.

Represent inventory item reservation information for a specific product and location.
    Use the new Inventory Item Reservation object.

Represent an individual transaction that records a change in the state and quantity of a specific
product item.
    Use the new Product Item Additional Transaction object.

Represent a request for product samples, including customer account details, request date, and
status.
    Use the new Sample Request object.

Represent sample or custom specification details associated with a sample request, including
quantity, price, and cost information.
    Use the new Sample Request Item object.

Represent a complete set of product requirements, including associated account and contact




689

    Salesforce Release Notes    Industries


information, lifecycle status, and relationships to requirement items and their versions.
        Use the new Product Requirement Specification object.

Represent a specific, measurable requirement within a requirement specification, defining delivery
expectations and verification criteria for a requested product.
        Use the new Product Requirement Specification Item object.

Represent a specific version of a requirement specification, capturing its purpose, scope, constraints,
and validation methods at a given point in time.
        Use the new Product Requirement Specification Version object.


    Changed Objects

    Store the quantity of product items that are allocated but not yet shipped.
    Use the new field Quantity Allocated on Product Item.

    Store the quantity of product items that are currently available in inventory.
    Use the new field Quantity Available on Product Item.

    Store the date and time when the quantity status of the product item was last updated.
    Use the new field Quantity State Refresh Date on Product Item.

 to adUnitId or targetedPlacementIds, and ASM maps identifiers to adUnitId (Ad Space) or

ingest your unstructured policy manuals. Then, activate the prebuilt Licensing, Permit, and Inspection

augmented generation (RAG) capabilities. Also, assess constituent Licensing and Permit needs using the

Answer Job Seeker Questions Instantly with Agentforce

Help job seekers learn about your agency’s mission, hiring policies, and processes by interacting with an
AI agent on your recruitment Experience Cloud site. Grounded in your policy manuals, the agent
provides accurate responses to candidate inquiries. Candidates can ask follow-up questions to refine
results, which helps them understand expectations and saves recruiters from answering repetitive
questions.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited editions
where Agentforce Public Sector, formerly Public Sector Solutions, and Data 360 are enabled, with the
Agentforce for Public Sector and Agentforce for Public Sector Community add-ons.

Who: The agent is available to authenticated and unauthenticated job seekers on your recruitment
Experience Cloud site.

Why: Candidates often have specific questions about job qualifications or work expectations that static
FAQs don’t cover. Instead of waiting for a recruiter to respond, candidates can converse with the agent to
get consistent information sourced directly from your agency’s policy manuals.

How: Upload your agency’s policy documents, FAQs, and mission statements to the Agentforce Data
Library to vectorize the data. Then, configure the Recruitment FAQ Agent to use this data to ground its
responses and add the agent to your recruitment site.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Recruitment Assistance with Agentforce

Collect Fees for Public Sector Services with Inbound Payments

Help constituents pay for services, such as license and permit applications, directly on your public facing
portal. By using Inbound Payments, you can embed a secure checkout flow into your Experience Cloud
site. This integration helps constituents settle fees digitally and gives agency employees real-time visibility
into payment status, reducing manual reconciliation and ensuring compliance before application
approval.


    706

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions where Agentforce Public Sector, formerly Public Sector Solutions, is active.

Why: Previously, agencies used disparate systems or in-person processing to collect fees, which
disconnected payments from application records. With Inbound Payments, you control financial
transactions directly within Salesforce. This integration links payments to specific requests, reducing
disputes. Compliance officers verify payment completion before authorizing services.

How: In Setup, configure your Service Catalog to define services and associated regulatory fees. Set up
your payment gateway, such as Stripe or Adyen, by using Salesforce Payments. Then, add the Payment
component to your Experience Cloud Lightning Web Runtime (LWR) site pages to expose the cart and
checkout flow to constituents.

Developer editions that have Agentforce Public Sector enabled.

Why: Previously, file size limits constrained the inclusion of rich media and large datasets. With this
increase to 300 MB available out of the box, you can consolidate all necessary information into a single
document file.

How: Public Sector Solutions automatically includes this feature.

New APIs in Agentforce Public Sector

Do more with the new API in Agentforce Public Sector, formerly Public Sector Solutions, objects.

Support for Regulatory Transaction Fee (RTF) Adjustments and Refunds

        The Recompute API is used when fees are recomputed, disputed, or cancelled. The adjustments
        to the existing Regulatory Transaction Fees (RTFs) can be positive or negative. For fee corrections,
        it automatically creates a new RTF against the original RTF and a corresponding new invoice for
        the adjusted amount. The original RTF is always set as the parent of the new RTF record. There
        are two types of adjustments:




     710

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

     •• Positive adjustments: Creates a new RTF and a new invoice for the additional fee.
        Negative adjustments: Creates a new negative RTF and a new invoice, automatically generates a
        credit memo against the original invoice, adjusts payments, and processes a refund.

Volunteer Management

Find qualified volunteers for open job shifts quickly with a generative AI agent. This action matches
volunteers based on their skills, location, and availability. To streamline your data integration, use the
new data model objects (DMOs) for Volunteer Management Intelligence. These DMOs reduce setup
complexity and eliminate the need for tedious, error-prone manual mapping to Data 360.

   Analyze Volunteer Data in Data 360 with Data Model Objects for Volunteer Management
   Combine the power of Data 360, formerly Data Cloud, with your Volunteer Management CRM data.
   Data model objects (DMOs) are now available in Data 360 for the entire Volunteer Management data
   model.
   Manage Volunteer Shifts with the Shift Capacity and Coverage Agent
   Easily identify shifts that need sign-ups and find the right volunteers to fill them by using the Find
   Unfilled Shifts and Match Volunteers to Shifts custom actions with the Shift Capacity and Coverage
   Agentforce topic. The Find Unfilled Shifts action searches for shifts by open capacity, time range, and
   optionally by Volunteer Initiative or Job Position. The Match Volunteers to Shifts action matches
   volunteers to the shifts by time, location, and qualification requirements.

Actionable Relationship Center

View many-to-one relationship type records on an Actionable Relationship Center (ARC) graph.

  Visualize More Relationships on an ARC Graph
  Show records related to each other via a many-to-one relationship type in ARC. The many-to-one
  relationship type uses a lookup relationship to link many records from an object to a single record
  from another object. In ARC, it shows a lookup field from the child node to the parent node. You can
  add one-to-many or many-to-many nodes to the child node. Previously, you could create an ARC graph
  by using only one-to-many or many-to-many relationship types.

Visualize More Relationships on an ARC Graph

Show records related to each other via a many-to-one relationship type in ARC. The many-to-one
relationship type uses a lookup relationship to link many records from an object to a single record from
another object. In ARC, it shows a lookup field from the child node to the parent node. You can add one-
to-many or many-to-many nodes to the child node. Previously, you could create an ARC graph by using
only one-to-many or many-to-many relationship types.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Professional, Enterprise, and Unlimited editions.

Batch Management

Use related object fields to control eligibility criteria and to group records for processing. Make the most
of the new enhancements to fast-track batch job runs. All Spring '26 Batch Management changes are
available for a limited set of process types, excluding the Flow process type.

  Use Related Object Fields to Build Granular Record Controls
  Optimize batch job filters with conditions that use related object fields to make sure jobs process only
  records relevant to the business process. A job that rejects presented quotes for lost opportunities on
  cold accounts can use filters on Opportunity and Account fields to include only relevant quotes.
  Improve Batch Job Reliability by Grouping Related Records
  Group records by using fields such as parent record ID to make batch jobs more reliable and prevent
  row lock errors. You can also group records by related object fields to make sure that the batch job
  processes records with common dependencies together. For example, you can group quotes by their
  related opportunity accounts to avoid conflicts during parallel processing.
  Boost Batch Job Performance with the Latest Enhancements
  Several enhancements make sure that batch jobs process records most efficiently and faster.
