Criteria-Based Search and Filter

Use Criteria-Based Search and Filter to design a search experience for your users. You can configure a
search based on a single object that unifies complex sets of data, such as inventory and aggregated
customer information that’s otherwise spread across multiple objects and fields. Criteria-Based Search
and Filter can be customized to meet varied business requirements.

  Optimize Search Experience with Consistent Data Display
  Criteria-Based Search and Filter (CBSF) now provides a more intuitive and reliable search experience
  with consistent data display and clear visibility into when data was last updated. Date-time fields
  appear in the user’s timezone using standard Salesforce formatting, and currency fields display
  symbols instead of codes. Any Word Search is enabled by default in all orgs, and users can view the
  Last Refreshed Date for search results, enhancing clarity and efficiency.

Optimize Search Experience with Consistent Data Display

Criteria-Based Search and Filter (CBSF) now provides a more intuitive and reliable search experience with
consistent data display and clear visibility into when data was last updated. Date-time fields appear in the
user’s timezone using standard Salesforce formatting, and currency fields display symbols instead of
codes. Any Word Search is enabled by default in all orgs, and users can view the Last Refreshed Date for
search results, enhancing clarity and efficiency.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience editions of Automotive Cloud, Health Cloud,
Manufacturing Cloud, Nonprofit Cloud, and Public Sector Solutions where Criteria-Based Search and
Filter is enabled.

Who: This feature is available to users with the Criteria-Based Search and Filter system permission.

How: These changes are automatically applied to the CBSF user interface, including the use of local
timezone formatting for date-time fields (e.g., 10/25/2024, 2:36 PM) and currency symbols (e.g., $)
instead of currency codes.

For administrators, to enable the Last Refreshed Date display, link the searchable object configuration to
the Data Processing Engine (DPE) that populates the flat entity data. The date will then appear at the top
of the search results.

Data Processing Engine

Preview how your definitions transform data and instantly validate and debug definition design right for

  Validate Logic and Debug Faster with Data Preview
  Validate your definition design instantly during creation. Generate data previews to verify that your
  configuration meets business needs and to identify logic errors. Use input variables to simulate
  different runtime conditions and apply data source filters to isolate specific datasets. Easily search the
  results to check whether definitions are working as expected. Intuitively correlate the results with node
  configurations and visualize how data flows across nodes.
  Run Definitions in Data 360 Companion Orgs
  Enhance your multi-org setup by creating definitions in companion orgs to transform data from data
  model objects (DMOs), data lake objects (DLOs), and calculated insights. You can decouple central
  business processes orchestrated in the home org from local processes managed in companion orgs.
  Get Holistic Insights About Definition Performance in a Single View
  Get comprehensive observations about the performance of definitions and their runs on the Analysis
  tab. Use the tab’s insights to stay informed about duration and data processing volumes for the latest
  and previous runs. Make informed decisions about your org’s Data Pipeline usage requirements by
  tracking the execution and writeback utilization numbers. Easily find the reasons and the remedies for
  failed runs.
  Get Actionable Guidance for Failed Runs

  run failure. The messages come with actionable solutions that empower you to fix issues related to
  definition design, access controls, and runtime platform setup or performance. You also get to know
  about the exact stage during the execution process when the run failed.
  Retrieve Details of Records that Failed Writeback

  download the failed records for each Writeback Object node with failed records. Use the failed record

Prevent Unnecessary Action Status Updates During MACD Operations

Preserve the Existing status on asset line items when Move, Add, Change, Delete (MACD) rules update
attribute properties without altering the actual values. Industries CPQ compares original and current
values to ensure only actual data modifications trigger a Change status. This logic prevents unnecessary
processing errors in downstream Order Management systems.

Where: This change applies to Classic and Lightning Experience in all editions with Communications,
Media, Energy & Utilities managed package.

Who: This feature is available to users with the Industries CPQ license and the necessary permissions to
configure and use Standard Cart APIs.

Why: Previously, both value modifications and metadata changes triggered a status update to Change.
Distinguishing modification types ensures that the Line Item Action Status remains Existing for behavior
changes, offering a clearer view of actual asset modifications.

How: From the CPQ Configuration Setup, enable the MACDLineItemActionStatus setting.

Support Larger-Scale Assets with Extended Asset Line Numbering

Maintain unique identifiers for high-volume accounts by expanding your asset identification scale. You
can manage up to 9,999,999 root assets without any duplicate numbering issues during assetization.
This enhancement ensures line number uniqueness within the context of each account.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions with Communications, Media, and Energy & Utilities managed package.

Who: This feature is available to users with the Industries CPQ license and the necessary permissions to
configure the system. It’s supported on both the Classic and Standard Cart APIs.

How: From the CPQ Configuration Setup, enable the ExtendedLineNumberModeEnabled CPQ custom
setting. Enabling this setting is permanent and irreversible to ensure continuous data integrity.

Process Compliance Navigator

Use Process Compliance Navigator to ensure your organization meets regulatory requirements, internal
policies, and industry standards. Compliance governance is strengthened with new validation criteria
enforcing auditable transitions for controls, regulations, and policies, ensuring consistent evidence.
Efficiency is improved by using context definitions for streamlined data access in validation and
Compliant Data Sharing for records.

  Control Compliance Record Access by Using Compliant Data Sharing
  Record owners in organizations with strict sharing policies can now grant other users access to their
  records by using Compliant Data Sharing for Process Compliance Navigator. Define record sharing
  rules for your compliance users so that record owners can share business operations processes,
  compliance policies, compliance regulations, compliance controls, and validation procedures with
  participant groups and participant roles.
  Achieve Audit Readiness with Compliance Control Testing
  Verify that your compliance controls are successfully mitigating risks and enforcing regulations and
  policies with compliance testing. This testing evaluates a control’s operating effectiveness, confirms its
  design function, and captures verifiable evidence during the execution of the test. Use these details to
  demonstrate to regulators and auditors that your compliance program works as intended.
  Enforce Compliance Control Testing Status Transition and Validation Criteria
  Strengthen your compliance framework and create an audit trail with the new Compliance Control
  Testing Status Transition and Validation Criteria setting. This setting enhances data governance by
  enforcing mandatory validation and transition rules whenever a user modifies the status of a
  Compliance Control Version Test Execution record. By locking down key attributes and transitions, this
  setting prevents the creation of inconsistent or unverifiable test evidence. For example, when the
  setting is turned on, enforce a rule that if the execution status is completed, a user can’t update it to a
  different value.
  Streamline Data Access with Context Definitions
  Define business context in your validation procedures with context definitions. A context definition
  acts as a structured data layer and translator that organizes data so that you can easily map and access
  relevant information across multiple objects. For example, to enforce compliance and prevent
  customer harassment, debt collection agencies must follow regulations that limit the number of times
  that they can call a customer. By using a context definition, you can now validate contact data, such as
  call frequency and time zone fields, before an agent initiates a call. The validation procedure passes in


    750

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

  contact record data to validate it for compliance, ensuring agents adhere to all call limitations.
  Clarify Purpose with the Renamed Logged-in User Locale Setting
  To ensure clarity and better reflect its purpose, the User Locale setting is now named Logged-in User
  Locale. This setting uses the logged-in user’s locale when logging API messages for Business Rules
  Engine compliance controls. Previously, this setting was called User Locale.
  Enforce Validation Criteria for Regulations and Policies
  Maintain an auditable and compliant lifecycle for managing your organization’s regulations and
  internal policies by using the Regulation and Policy Status Transition and Validation Criteria setting.
  Acting as a governance gatekeeper for compliance officers, the setting enforces criteria before
  updating regulation version or compliance policy version.
  Track Policies and Regulations that Govern Your Assets
  Improve the traceability of your regulated hardware and software assets by mapping regulation clause
  versions, compliance policy clause versions, and compliance control versions to an asset. Use this
  structure to maintain a record of the policies and regulations governing your assets, visualize control
  relationships, report on coverage gaps, and demonstrate adequate control implementation for
  compliance.
  New Agentforce Process Compliance Navigator Jumpstart Bundles
  Quickly get started with Agentforce Process Compliance Navigator by using preconfigured features and
  flows designed to reduce setup time and complexity.
  New Objects in Process Compliance Navigator
  Do more with these new and updated Process Compliance Navigator objects.

Enforce Compliance Control Testing Status Transition and Validation Criteria

Strengthen your compliance framework and create an audit trail with the new Compliance Control
Testing Status Transition and Validation Criteria setting. This setting enhances data governance by
enforcing mandatory validation and transition rules whenever a user modifies the status of a Compliance
Control Version Test Execution record. By locking down key attributes and transitions, this setting
prevents the creation of inconsistent or unverifiable test evidence. For example, when the setting is
turned on, enforce a rule that if the execution status is completed, a user can’t update it to a different
value.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Developer, Enterprise, and Unlimited editions
with Process Compliance Navigator.

How: From Setup, select Compliance, and then select Compliance Control Testing Status Transition
and Validation Criteria.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Process Compliance Navigator: Turn on Compliance Control Testing Status Transition
  and Validation Criteria (can be outdated or unavailable during release preview)

Streamline Data Access with Context Definitions

Define business context in your validation procedures with context definitions. A context definition acts
as a structured data layer and translator that organizes data so that you can easily map and access
relevant information across multiple objects. For example, to enforce compliance and prevent customer


    752

Salesforce Release Notes Industries

harassment, debt collection agencies must follow regulations that limit the number of times that they
can call a customer. By using a context definition, you can now validate contact data, such as call
frequency and time zone fields, before an agent initiates a call. The validation procedure passes in
contact record data to validate it for compliance, ensuring agents adhere to all call limitations.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Developer, Enterprise, and Unlimited editions
with Process Compliance Navigator.

How: Create a context definition by choosing nodes, defining their relationship, adding attributes, and
applying context tags. Add the context definition context ID to the validation procedure.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Process Compliance Navigator: Configure a Validation Procedure (can be outdated or
  unavailable during release preview)

Clarify Purpose with the Renamed Logged-in User Locale Setting

To ensure clarity and better reflect its purpose, the User Locale setting is now named Logged-in User
Locale. This setting uses the logged-in user’s locale when logging API messages for Business Rules Engine
compliance controls. Previously, this setting was called User Locale.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Developer, Enterprise, and Unlimited editions
with Process Compliance Navigator.

How: From Setup, select Compliance, and then select Logged-in User Locale.

  Salesforce Help: Process Compliance Navigator: User Locale Setting (can be outdated or unavailable

Enforce Validation Criteria for Regulations and Policies

Maintain an auditable and compliant lifecycle for managing your organization’s regulations and internal
policies by using the Regulation and Policy Status Transition and Validation Criteria setting. Acting as a
governance gatekeeper for compliance officers, the setting enforces criteria before updating regulation
version or compliance policy version.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Developer, Enterprise, and Unlimited editions
with Process Compliance Navigator.

Why: This setting prevents premature activation or incorrect retirement of rules so that your organization
always operates on the legally effective version of a regulation or policy. For example, you can publish a
regulation version only when all of the associated regulation clause versions are published or active.
Previously, users could update the status field on the regulation version or compliance policy version
without enforced transition and validation criteria.

How: From Setup, select Compliance, and then select Regulation and Policy Status Transition and

Validation Criteria.

 Validation Criteria (can be outdated or unavailable during release preview)

compliance.

  Lower the Barrier to Entry with Guest Access for Program Management
  Potential participants can now browse your programs and benefits on an Experience Cloud site

  good match. When they’re ready, they can easily submit a referral to begin the intake process, which
  reduces friction and increases engagement with your nonprofit.
  Simplify On-The-Go Attendance Tracking for Your Staff
  Taking attendance for benefit sessions is now faster and easier for staff working in the field. The
  attendance experience is optimized in the Salesforce mobile app to facilitate quick data capture. Staff
  can use their phones or tablets to find sessions or participants, update single or multiple participant
  records at once, and save their work with confidence. Capturing data in real time reduces
  administrative work and improves accuracy, so that your team spends less time on data entry and
  more time on your mission.
  Streamline Participant Intake with a Guided Work Flow
  The new Intake app guides intake coordinators through a more efficient enrollment process with the

  Separately, the Complete Application flow automates the creation of enrollment records and cases,
  which provides a smooth hand-off to case managers.
  Confirm Participant Program Eligibility in Real Time
  Save staff time, reduce manual errors, and improve the participant application experience by checking
  participant eligibility for programs instantly. Create robust eligibility criteria that are unique to each
  program, and check a participant’s eligibility against their participant record on an application with the
  Business Rules Engine. Intake coordinators can see a participant’s status, which helps them make
  faster decisions and prevent non-compliant enrollments.

by using complex qualification logic that designers can easily build and deploy. Optimize your Service
Process creation with improved attribute organization, support for more data types, and clearer display
of record information. Equip service reps and internal request fulfillers to validate product eligibility for
customers and employees by using the Check Product Eligibility Agentforce action.

Campaign Preview action. We’ve also updated the Save Campaign and Generate Campaign from Brief
flows and the Draft Campaign from Brief Prompt template. Related flows also now include improved
error handling and campaign preview steps.

Engage Customers with Conversational Email

Turn one-way email broadcasts into dynamic, two-way interactions. Conversational Email engages
customers through responsive, threaded conversations that are powered by Agentforce agents. Capture
high-intent replies, resolve customer queries, and deliver personalized support, without leaving the
Salesforce platform. Flow Builder enhancements, including Wait Until Response, and conversation
forwarding enable customers to convert any existing one-way campaigns to two-way campaigns.

How: Use Campaign Agent to easily create two-way conversational campaigns. Provide a user utterance
or select an option in the campaign brief, and Campaign Agent generates a preview of a standard two-
way email and SMS campaign. It automatically includes the flow elements needed to support two-way
conversations with the Default Agent.

Draft Marketing Briefs Based on Existing Strategic Documents

To ground a campaign brief in existing content, upload documents, such as PDFs or Word files, into
Salesforce Files and mention them in your prompt. The agent automatically processes the file grounding,
generates the brief, and adds a link to the source documents in the new brief record.

content, match each business unit to a division, brand, or region. Teams can stay focused on their goals,
while leadership enjoys enterprise-wide visibility. To ensure data separation, map each business unit to a
unique data space.

Where: These changes apply to Salesforce Enterprise and Unlimited editions with Marketing Cloud
Advanced edition.

Why: Business units allow you to maintain compliance, align messaging with audiences, and measure
your marketing performance. Business units support these capabilities.

•• Create up to 50 business units per org.

   Align a business unit’s data with its respective data space by adding filters on marketing DLOs
• automatically.

   Assign channels (Email, SMS, WhatsApp, and Mobile App Messaging) and subscriptions to a single or
• all business units.
   View marketing performance for a business unit or create a business unit to capture performance at
• the enterprise level.

   Frequency, and Engagement Scoring and tell Agentforce which business unit to operate for the

Build Richer, More Personalized Emails and Share Consistent Templates

Marketers can build richer emails with the rich text editing toolbar in paragraph components and by

email authors can create more sophisticated and deeply personalized messages with Handlebars

Where: These changes apply to Salesforce Enterprise and Unlimited editions with access to Marketing

Share Marketing-Approved Email Templates with Non-Marketing Users

To increase productivity without sacrificing brand consistency, marketers can now share approved email
templates built in Marketing Cloud Next with sales reps and other users. After a marketer creates an
email template, they can add it to a flow and lock or unlock specific components. Publishing the flow
makes the email template available in an easy email composer that’s ready to use. An admin must turn
on Distributed Marketing and Alerts in Setup, and adds the required Lightning components to record
pages.

SEE ALSO | Salesforce Help: Distributed Marketing and Alerts Overview

SEE ALSO | Salesforce Help: Set Up Distributed Marketing and Alerts

Enforce Brand Standards with Email Template Locks

Marketing managers can now ensure brand consistency by locking specific elements on an email
template. Protect critical content—such as subject lines, headers, and legal disclaimers—and prevent
accidental changes by authors. While fixed elements remain secure, authors retain the flexibility to
customize unlocked areas. Visual indicators in the component tree clearly show which sections are non-
editable.

Google Adds “via” Tag to System Emails

System emails that are sent to Google Group email addresses now include a "via" tag in the From
address.

The “via” tag is a security feature that’s added to a message sent on behalf of another sender or
domain—in this case, a message from info@pardot.com for your domain. This tag helps prevent email
spoofing and enhances security so that recipients can identify an email’s true origin.

•• Old Format—Marketing Cloud Account Engagement <info@pardot.com>
   New Format—“‛Marketing Cloud Account Engagement’ via Group-Name”
   <YourGroup@Yourdomain.com>

Where: This change applies to Salesforce Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited editions with any
Marketing Cloud Account Engagement edition.

  Improve Event Notification Service (ENS) Reliability
  The new 7-day retry window prevents users from experiencing dropped batches due to unsuccessful
  delivery attempts. When a batch of notification events fails to deliver, ENS retries delivery at periodic,
  decreasing intervals for up to 7 days. After that, retries stop and delivery fails. Previously, ENS
  suspended callback URLs immediately after a failed delivery.

Improve Precision in Salesforce Data Entry Events

We increased the precision of Salesforce Data Entry events in Journey Builder. The Is Updated operator
on Entry Criteria now compares a field's before and after values to more accurately detect any changes to
CRM objects, so that more contacts can enter journeys at the right time. For example, a contact whose
Onboarding Status field changes from In Progress to Completed now correctly qualifies for journey entry,
allowing automation based on specific customer lifecycle changes.

and Journey Builder.

Improve Event Notification Service (ENS) Reliability

The new 7-day retry window prevents users from experiencing dropped batches due to unsuccessful
delivery attempts. When a batch of notification events fails to deliver, ENS retries delivery at periodic,
decreasing intervals for up to 7 days. After that, retries stop and delivery fails. Previously, ENS suspended
callback URLs immediately after a failed delivery.

Where: This change applies to all Marketing Cloud Engagement editions.

Salesforce Release Notes Marketing

Define Rotation Policies for Client Secrets

To improve the security of your API integrations, set a rotation policy for OAuth 2.0 client secrets. When
you define a rotation period for an integration’s client secret, your marketing admins get email reminders
when a secret is due for rotation.

Updated Expiration Policy for Client Secrets for API Integrations

Beginning March 23, 2026, all client secrets for API integrations have a 180-day expiration period, which
begins when you generate the secret. Client secrets generated before this date expire on September 30,
2026. Newly generated client secrets contain 64 characters and begin with SFMC_ . To view expiration
dates for your client secrets, see the summary table on the Installed Packages page in Setup.

Secret

button to remove all records in a data extension, that data moves to the Cleared Data folder and remains
there for 30 days. If you unintentionally clear the data from a data extension, you can restore it into a
new data extension.

to restore, and then click Restore.

Salesforce Release Notes Marketing

Salesforce Personalization and Marketing Cloud Personalization products. Learn about the latest features
and updates to enhance personalized experiences across Salesforce clouds.

  Personalization Features Released by Month
  Salesforce Personalization and Marketing Cloud Personalization features and changes are released as
  often as monthly, so check back again soon for the latest updates. When announced, changes
  included in the Spring release will appear under January ’26.
  Maximize Revenue with Impactful Promotion Recommendations
  To ensure promotions stay relevant and drive purchases, the new out-of-the-box recommender uses
  real-time engagement signals and order history to suggest offers your customers are likely to use. This
  update simplifies handling promotions that are indirectly tied to products, ensuring customers see the
  most impactful offers. After configuring profile and item data graphs with the necessary Data 360
  entities in Salesforce Personalization, you’re all set to add this capability to any personalization point.
  Personalize Decision Responses with Merge Fields
  You are no longer limited to one-size-fits-all messages in decision responses. Deliver personalized
  decision responses to your users by adding merge fields from profile data graphs. Include direct
  attributes such as your user’s first name in decision responses or segment IDs to use in personalization
  campaigns in third party apps. For instance, personally greet a user and display their current loyalty
  points in an infobar. This flexibility ensures every interaction is tailored to the individual, turning
  generic notifications into meaningful, data-driven touchpoints.
  Use Real-Time Calculated Affinities to Gain Customer Preference Insights
  Calculated affinities measure characteristics that indicate a customer’s interest in or liking of an object.
  Create and use real-time calculated affinities with personalization point targeting rules, segments, and
  recommendation filters to generate highly focused personalized content based on customer
  preferences.
  Build Data 360 Sitemaps for Personalization Using the Sitemap Builder
  Create Data 360 sitemaps and schema using a low-code to no-code Chrome extension tool.
  Sort Rule-Based Recommendations Meaningfully
  You can now sort recommendations using direct attributes from item data graphs or calculated
  insights from profile data graphs. For example, to display the most recently viewed products at the top
  of your recommendations, configure the recommender to sort products by the engagement date and
  time in descending order. With this flexibility, you can rank recommendations based on specific user
  interactions such as favorited items, direct item attributes such as inventory count, or external
  intelligence such as brand affinity score from an external system.
  Show or Hide Recommendations Based on Date and Time
  Provide more precise targeting by using the new Is Before Current DateTime and Is After Current
  DateTime operators in a recommendation filter. These operators show or hide recommendations
  based on the current date and time.
  Automate Testing Using Experimentation as a Service
  Run experiments across web and server-side environments by integrating the new Experiment
  Connect and Runtime Experiment Assignment APIs directly into your workflows. Automate winner
  selection testing and deploy relevant customer experiences without manual intervention.
  Set Up Salesforce Personalization With an Improved Workflow

Salesforce Release Notes                                Marketing

  We’ve reorganized some Salesforce Personalization Setup pages to improve the foundational data and
  intelligence setup experience. This updated workflow changes how you select and manage data
  spaces for Salesforce Personalization data deployment and intelligence dashboard installation.
  Extend Marketing Cloud Personalization Data with Marketing Cloud Next for Personalization
  Using purpose-built tools, quickly and efficiently transfer Marketing Cloud Personalization metadata
  and catalog data to portable files, and use existing processes to import it into Data 360 for use with
  Salesforce Personalization.
  Personalize Mobile Experiences with Engagement Mobile SDK
  The Personalization module within the Engagement Mobile SDK queries the Personalization service to
  deliver targeted content to your iOS and Android apps. By integrating with the Data 360 module, you
  capture customer interactions and build behavior profiles. Use the returned data to drive real-time
  personalization decisions.
  Curate Website Content with Agentforce Adaptive Websites
  Guide your users through every step of their website browsing journey by dynamically curating
  relevant, context-aware site content in real time. Agentforce Adaptive Websites displays the right
  recommendations, images, and adapts messaging tone based on real-time user behavior signals from
  an SDK combined with your data. Keep your customers engaged and assist them in accomplishing
  their mission without leaving your brand’s site.

automatically replaced with the current date.

••   Reset Qualifying Points
•    Expire Fixed Non-Qualifying Points
•    Expire Activity Based Non-Qualifying Points
•    Expire Fixed Non-Qualifying Points Using Aggregated Expiration Ledgers
•    Expire Non-Qualifying Points Using Traceability Loyalty Ledgers
     Expire Fixed Non-Qualifying Points Using Aggregation Ledgers and Trace Ledgers

How: To get the latest updates, replace the existing Data Processing Engine definition templates with the
enhanced templates.

MuleSoft

Use the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform suite of products to connect and integrate apps, systems, and data
across your enterprise. Streamline operations by building and automating processes with clicks instead
of code. You can design, develop, govern, and share APIs and integration apps and host them in the
cloud or on-premises.

   Experience a Consistent URL Handling Journey Across Platforms
   Branded apps now provide a more reliable and unified linking experience for users on both Android
   and iOS. We aligned URL handling logic to make sure that links, whether clicked during login or while
   navigating your site, behave consistently regardless of the platform.
   Access Near Field Communication (NFC) Capabilities on Mobile Publisher Apps

Experience a Consistent URL Handling Journey Across Platforms

Branded apps now provide a more reliable and unified linking experience for users on both Android and
iOS. We aligned URL handling logic to make sure that links, whether clicked during login or while
navigating your site, behave consistently regardless of the platform.

Where: This change applies to Mobile Publisher for Experience Cloud apps. Setup for Mobile Publisher is
available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited editions.

Why: Previously, Android and iOS used different logic when deciding how to open a URL. For example,
Android validated only the domain of a URL, whereas iOS validated both the domain and the specific
Experience Cloud site path. This inconsistency often led to Android incorrectly treating links to external
sites on the same domain as Experience Cloud site URLs, causing them to open incorrectly within the
app.

Also, Android's handling of unconfigured login URLs sometimes caused failures during multi-factor
authentication (MFA) because intermediate authentication URLs weren’t recognized. These updates
bring Android in line with the reliable behavior of iOS to prevent these disruptions.

How: URL handling now follows a unified precedence model for all event triggers.

• Intercepted Login URLs: If a URL is intercepted during the login process and isn’t explicitly defined in
   URL Management, it now continues to open within the login page automatically. This makes sure that
• intermediate authentication steps, such as MFA, work without extra configuration.
   In-App interception: Any link clicked within the app that isn't configured in URL Management now
• defaults to opening within the app on both platforms.
   Improved Path Validation: Android now validates both the domain and the specific community path,
   matching the iOS standard. For example, in the URL https://capricornjuices.my.site.com/
   capricornjuices/s/, the domain is https://capricornjuices.my.site.com, and site path is



    828

Salesforce Release Notes Mobile

  capricornjuices/s/.

Access Near Field Communication (NFC) Capabilities on Mobile Publisher
Apps

Give users of Mobile Publisher apps the ability to use near field communication (NFC) to streamline
workflows. NFC technology enables the device to read, erase, and write to tags natively.

Where: This change applies to Mobile Publisher for Experience Cloud apps. Setup for Mobile Publisher is
available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited editions.

How: Enable the Near Field Communication permission in Setup > Mobile Publisher > [app name].
Then create a Lightning Web component for your specific NFC-related use case, and add it to your app in
Experience Builder.

See Also
  Salesforce Developer Blog: Introducing the NFCService Mobile Capability

  Seamlessly Migrate from Vlocity Industries Managed Package or Omnistudio Foundation Package
  with Standard Data Model to Omnistudio Standard Runtime by Using the Omnistudio Migration
  Assistant
  Automate and simplify your Omnistudio component migration with the new Omnistudio Migration
  Assistant, a Salesforce CLI plug-in. The tool helps you migrate your components such as Flexcards,
  Omniscripts, Data Mappers, Integration Procedures, Omni Global Auto Numbers, custom labels, and

  (LWCs) from the Vlocity Industries managed package or Omnistudio Foundation package with

  Omnistudio for managed packages now enforces advanced security settings to protect data and

  users can access data only through authorised and secure channels.
  Enforced Security Checks for Omnistudio
  Omnistudio now enforces advanced security settings to protect data and maintain system integrity.
  These controls ensure that all users, including guest and unauthenticated users can access data only
  through authorised and secure channels.
  Automate UI Testing for Omniscripts and Flexcards
  Omnistudio now supports comprehensive UI testing for guided experiences and visual components

Seamlessly Migrate from Vlocity Industries Managed Package or
Omnistudio Foundation Package with Standard Data Model to
Omnistudio Standard Runtime by Using the Omnistudio Migration
Assistant

Automate and simplify your Omnistudio component migration with the new Omnistudio Migration
Assistant, a Salesforce CLI plug-in. The tool helps you migrate your components such as Flexcards,


    833

Salesforce Release Notes Omnistudio

Omniscripts, Data Mappers, Integration Procedures, Omni Global Auto Numbers, custom labels, and
related objects such as Apex classes, FlexiPages, Experience Cloud pages, Lightning web components
(LWCs) from the Vlocity Industries managed package or Omnistudio Foundation package with standard
data model to Omnistudio standard runtime.

     Note Use the Omnistudio Migration Assistant version 2.0.0-rc.59 or later.

     Note The Omnistudio Migration Assistant doesn’t support migrating Omni Global Auto Numbers if
     you’re migrating from Omnistudio Foundation package and standard data model to Omnistudio
     standard runtime.

Where: This feature is available in all Salesforce editions.

Who: This feature is available to Omnistudio customers who are migrating from Vlocity Industries
managed package or Omnistudio Foundation package with standard data model to Omnistudio
standard runtime.

Why: Use the Omnistudio Migration Assistant to streamline and accelerate your migration process. The
tool offers these key benefits:

•• Automates complex migration tasks and reduces manual efforts.
• Ensures configuration consistency across environments.
• Replaces legacy wrappers with standard runtime wrappers.
• Updates namespace references and cleans record names automatically.
• Validates components with built-in checks and detailed assessment and migration reports.
   Identifies components that are ready for migration, require manual action, or are skipped or failed, all
   in one place.

How: To use the Omnistudio Migration Assistant, first install the tool by using Salesforce CLI. After
installation, run the tool in Assess mode in your production and testing sandboxes to evaluate your org’s
migration readiness and generate an assessment report. Carefully review the report and resolve any
issues identified. After all pre-migration issues are addressed, run the tool in Migrate mode to
automatically migrate your components to the standard data model and Omnistudio standard runtime.
After the migration completes, review the migration reports to verify that your components were
successfully migrated and are functioning as expected.

     Important Don’t deploy migrated components from the sandbox to your production environment
     currently. To deploy these components to your production environment, contact Salesforce
     Customer Support.

Automate UI Testing for Omniscripts and Flexcards

Omnistudio now supports comprehensive UI testing for guided experiences and visual components by
using the UI Test Automation Model (UTAM) framework. UTAM improves deployment reliability by
validating end-to-end workflows. Write UI-driven tests for Omniscripts and Flexcards that validate full
user journeys exactly as they appear on screen. UTAM interacts directly with the interface to test user
inputs, navigation, actions, data rendering, and visual states.

Where: This change applies to Aura and LWR sites accessed through Lightning Experience in Enterprise,
Performance, and Unlimited editions where Omnistudio is enabled.

Who: This feature is available to Omnistudio customers who use the standard runtime and standard
designer.

Why: UTAM offers these key benefits:


    835

Salesforce Release Notes Omnistudio

• Abstracts Document Object Model (DOM) changes to keep UI tests stable, even when platform
• updates modify layouts.
   Simulates real user interactions across Omnscripts and Flexcards for end-to-end validation, from data
• entry to conditional logic.
   Uses Page Object Model (POM) to organize reusable Page Objects (POs), simplifying test creation and
   maintenance.

How: To use UTAM for automated UI testing, first install and configure your preferred test runner (for
example, WebDriverIO or TestNG) to work with the UTAM framework. Next, leverage the Omnistudio
UTAM POs to create custom POs for your Omniscripts or Flexcards, abstracting common UI elements,
such as steps, inputs, and buttons. Then, build your test scripts on top of these custom POs by using
helper methods to launch the Omniscript, set field values, and perform navigation actions. Finally, verify
that the end-to-end user journey, validations, and element behaviors work as expected.

See Also
   Salesforce Help for Omnistudio: Automated Testing with UTAM for Omnistudio

Accessibility Enhancements in Omnistudio

Build inclusive user interfaces by using the accessibility enhancements in Flexcard and Omniscript
elements. These enhancements cover many accessibility requirements, such as enhanced screen reader
announcements, easier navigation, and a more powerful UI experience. Some enhancements are only
available when you turn on the Runtime Accessibility setting in the Flexcard and Omniscript designers.
For instance, this setting unlocks new properties for elements such as Radio, Radio Group, Block, and
Data Table. Other changes apply even without turning on this setting, such as new custom attributes for
icons, autocomplete options in several elements, and so on.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience, Experience Cloud sites, and all versions of
Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited editions where Omnistudio is enabled.

Who: This feature is available to Omnistudio customers who use the standard runtime. However,
changes under the Runtime Accessibility toggle apply to Omnistudio customers who use the standard
runtime and designer. All changes are available for the SLDS and SLDS+ themes.

Why: These enhancements make your components meet WCAG 2.2 web accessibility standards, helping
screen reader and keyboard-only users navigate your applications more effectively. Specific
improvements include:

•  Improved Semantics: Navigate actions now use real links rather than placeholder links. Screen readers
•  announce when links open in a new window.
   Enhanced Navigation: Keyboard users can now access edit icons in Data Tables on focus. All actions
•  support Space, Enter, and Escape keys.
   Better Visual Feedback: Selected options in Multi-select and Radio elements now display a checkmark
   for clearer visual indication beyond color alone.

How: To access the optional enhancements, open your Flexcard or Omniscript in the standard designer,
select Setup, and enable the Runtime Accessibility toggle.

When you enable the Runtime Accessibility setting, these changes become available:

•  Radio
    --  Improved keyboard navigation.
        Support for new attributes: role=radiogroup , aria-required and aria-invalid .
•   - Image and color-pick radio buttons now show a visible checkmark when selected.
   Radio Group
    --  The Set All checkbox now behaves correctly at runtime and can’t be unchecked once set.
        When tabbed out of a required radio group without making a selection, validation is triggered and
        an error message is shown.
•   - The DOM structure is updated for better accessibility.
   Block
    - Heading Level: You can now configure the heading level (H1-H6) for blocks to enforce a logical
        document structure.
    - Delete Confirmation: A confirmation dialog is shown before deleting a block.


        837

Salesforce Release Notes        Omnistudio

•  Typeahead
    - An Edit Icon Label field is added so you can specify a name for the name of the edit icon. The
        default remains Edit, but you can customize the label as per your preference. This change is
        specific to the edit mode.
    - The option list container’s border maintains the minimum contrast ratio of 3:1 with its background
        color. This change is specific to SLDS Plus theme.
    - When the dropdown menu opens, focus is automatically set to the first selectable option. This
        change is specific to the Lookup mode.

•  Action:
    --  Navigate actions now announce when something opens in a new window.
        Keyboard navigation is enhanced to mirror mouse click behavior.

These improvements are available automatically without enabling the Accessibility toggle:

•  Set as Disabled Property for Inputs: A new Set as disabled property is available for these elements, so
   that you can explicitly disable them on the pages that they’re used on.
    --  Currency, Email, Number, Password, Range, Telephone, Text, Text Area, URL, and Lookup.
        Checkbox: The Read-Only property is replaced by Set as disabled.
•   - Multi-select: The Set as disabled property is added.
   Select:
    --  The default placeholder "--Clear -–" is changed to "No Value".
        Focus remains on the input while typing.
    --  Value changes are reflected immediately.
•       The autocomplete input field is added.
   Lookup:

        With the new Clear Value option, you can clear the pre-selected value when the dropdown opens.

        The search icon is removed from the runtime view.

                    Visual contrast is improved for better readability.
    - Multi-Select:-
                    Image multi-select options now display a visible checkmark.

For components that previously supported the iconNameLeft and iconNameRight custom attributes,
two new custom attributes have been added: iconNameLeftAltText and iconNameRightAltText. These
new attributes provide alternative text support.

Partner Cloud

Start managing the full partner lifecycle in one place with tools built directly into Salesforce. Use Partner
Cloud to recruit, onboard, enable, and co-sell with partners while giving them secure access to the data
and workflows they need. Bring together key capabilities like deal registration, incentives, training, and
performance tracking so your team can scale indirect sales and improve partner relationships. Partner
Cloud helps you do more with the partners you already have—faster, and with less manual work.

  Automate Referral Tracking with B2B Referral Flows
  Use the B2B Referral Lead Flow and B2B Referral Opportunity Flow to create referral entities
  automatically. The flows manage the referral lifecycle, from lead creation and qualification to
  opportunity closure and reward issuance. When a partner submits a lead, the Lead flow creates
  referral records and manages status updates as the lead moves from new to qualified. When an
  opportunity is won, the Opportunity flow updates the referral records and issues the appropriate
  rewards.
  Create and Track Joint Business Plans with Your Partners
  A joint business plan, now generally available, helps channel managers and partner reps align on
  shared goals, KPIs, and actions for a defined planning period. Capture strategic priorities, build
  measurable objectives, define action plans, and collaborate with partners. This release adds a
  dedicated joint account plan record type, enhanced objective measure support, Partner Central
  access, and purpose-built templates for partner planning.
  Include Referral Codes in Deal Registrations
  Support tracking and reward attribution by giving partners referral codes to submit when they register
  a deal. The referral code field is captured on both Lead and Opportunity records for visibility across the
  sales process.
  Monitor Partner Success Agent Performance with Agent Analytics
  Gain a complete overview of your Partner Success Agent’s effectiveness and usage metrics with the
  Agent Analytics dashboard. Channel leaders can now track partner engagement, deflection rates, and
  session trends to optimize performance. Filter data by time frame, channel, topic, or action to pinpoint
  specific insights. Access these metrics directly from the Agent for Studio Analytics tab.

  searchable and filterable attributes, which improves product discovery for large catalogs. Users can

  Salesforce Pricing
  Define pricing rules across complex, multi-level quotes by using conditional ascending propagation
  and cross-field horizontal calculations. Simplify pricing logic with conditional IF statements. Accelerate
  debugging by using auto-numbered steps and element descriptions in the now-renamed Revenue
  Cloud Operations Console. Improve troubleshooting accuracy with Advanced Price Log Settings and
  seamlessly deploy entire pricing workflow structures by packaging procedure plans.
  Product Configurator
  Deliver clear, localized troubleshooting guidance with full translation support for every run-time
  message. Complete complex bundle configurations faster by using a streamlined interface to edit
  attributes and clone product instances directly from component option cards. Improve configuration
  performance with non-blocking UI behavior for options, and troubleshoot configurations with
  configuration logs. Access the Configurator API by using a Lightning web component, and use
  Lightning Message Service events to update fields in a third-party Configurator component.
  Transaction Management
  Manage complex deal structures easily by creating multiple ramp schedule groups, and amend
  ramped and nonramped assets in a single transaction. Set up quote line import effortlessly in
  multicurrency orgs, and automatically populate records related to imported quote lines. Handle
  transactions easily with advanced filtering, automated and persistent line sorting, and faster instant
  pricing. Process amendment, renewal, or cancellation transactions before the start date of an existing
  future-dated order.
  Advanced Approvals
  As an approval designer, use custom flow logic to auto-approve resubmitted records. Approve high-
  value record requests faster by overriding approval conditions easily. Enhance your smart approval
  logic by configuring step conditions with eight additional data types and up to 30 conditions for
  approval stage and step criteria. Create detailed approval email templates for up to 8 different

Increase Sales by Using Promotions in Agentforce Revenue Management
(Beta)

Empower pricing designers to create manual and automatic promotions that offer discounts on products
and categories. Designers define promotion eligibility based on rules and sales channels, and specify
how to evaluate multiple applied promotions. Show your users, such as sales reps, partners, and
customers, these promotions when they browse products and catalogs. Apply automatic promotions to
lines when users add products to transactions. Users can apply manual promotions when they configure
products and manage lines. They can see applied discounts in the price waterfall and the applied
promotions on assets. They can also apply promotions when they amend or renew assets.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions of Agentforce Revenue Management, formerly Revenue Cloud, with the Revenue
Cloud Advanced license.

Who: To see and apply promotions, users need the Apply Promotions on Sales Transactions permission
set.

recurring revenue stream by using promotions.

Pricing designers provide a 10% discount on a bundled product, QuantumBit Complete Solution, when
users buy the product with an annual subscription. They also provide an additional 20% discount on an
optional child product, QuantumBit Essentials Training, when customers buy it as part of the bundle.

        Use the new AssetActionSrcPriceAdjustment object.

        Use the AppliedPromotionDate field on the existing OrderItemAdjustmentLineItem object.

Product Catalog Management

Manage product data in the cache by generating, refreshing, or emptying it, offering flexible options to
synchronize data efficiently. Product Catalog Management now supports higher configurable limits for
searchable and filterable attributes, which improves product discovery for large catalogs. Users can select
more than 20 products during product discovery and add them to a transaction.

  Simplified Product Data Cache Refresh
  You can now easily manage product data in the cache by generating the cache for all products,
  refreshing existing products, or emptying the entire cache. This enhancement provides flexible,
  controlled options to synchronize your data. You can choose the action that best meets your cache
  management requirements for maximum efficiency. End-users benefit from optimal loading times and
  access to the latest product details via the Product Detail API.
  Select More Products During Product Discovery
  Select more than 20 products during product discovery and add them to a transaction. The updated
  Bulk Product Details API now retrieves comprehensive details for a greater number of products
  simultaneously. This change benefits customers who frequently select multiple products from a
  category, leading to faster and more efficient transactions.
  Find Products Faster in Large Catalogs with Increased Search Limits
  Product Catalog Management now supports higher configurable limits for searchable and filterable
  attributes and fields. This enhancement helps customers with large product catalogs to improve
  product discovery using more flexible search criteria.
  New and Changed Connect REST APIs in Product Catalog Management
  Specify Enterprise Product Catalog (EPC) as a catalog source, and extend Product Details API to
  support your unique custom fields and objects. You can also get product classification details for EPC
  with the new API enhancements.

Define pricing rules across complex, multi-level quotes by using conditional ascending propagation and
cross-field horizontal calculations. Simplify pricing logic with conditional IF statements. Accelerate
debugging by using auto-numbered steps and element descriptions in the now-renamed Revenue Cloud
Operations Console. Improve troubleshooting accuracy with Advanced Price Log Settings and seamlessly
deploy entire pricing workflow structures by packaging procedure plans.

  Streamline Complex Quote Calculations with Smarter Price Propagation
  Manage complex, multi-level quotes by defining formulas that calculate and propagate discounts and
  totals throughout the quote hierarchy. Simplify pricing configuration for complex quote structures with
  up to 5 levels of nesting. Build consistent pricing flows by using ascending propagation to conditionally
  roll up totals and discounts to the parent level. Use horizontal calculations to compute values based
  on other fields within the same quote line or group.
  Package Your Pricing Workflow Seamlessly
  Migrate entire pricing solutions across Salesforce orgs by adding procedure plans directly to your
  deployment package. Transfer the complete execution flow of pricing and discovery procedures to
  reduce manual setup effort. Deploy your validated pricing workflow with speed and accuracy to ensure

  immediate consistency in every target org.

  Use Advanced Price Log Settings to collect detailed diagnostic data for complex pricing elements. The
  logs capture input values and complete exception details for elements such as Attribute-Based Price,
  Derived Price, and other logic-heavy elements. This framework streamlines troubleshooting and
  performance analysis so that admins can identify the root cause of issues.
  Build Pricing Logic with Conditional IF Statements
  Solve complex pricing scenarios by using conditional IF statements and nested logic directly within the
  Formula-Based Pricing element. Pricing designers can now replicate complex business logic, such as
  intricate claculations for product pricing by using basis points or advanced logic for promotional

  accelerates debugging.

Enable Non-Blocking UI Behavior for Attributes and Options

With non-blocking UI behavior for attributes and options, you can change multiple values on a product
without waiting for system response, to speed up the configuration process. After the changes load,
actions including Save, Save and Exit, Cancel, and Update Prices are available.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions of Agentforce Revenue Management, formerly Revenue Cloud, with the Revenue
Cloud Growth or the Revenue Cloud Advanced license.

How: To turn on non-blocking behavior for attribute and option values, in your product configuration
flow, for the Data Manager component properties, set Non-Blocking Enabled to true. Quantity values are
no longer supported for non-blocking UI behavior. Quantity changes are blocked when API calls are in
progress.

        Use the new Option Card Attributes Limit attribute of the Input type on the Product

        Use the new Eligible Promotions attribute. It's of Input type on the Product Configurator

        Use the new Messages attribute of the Input type on the Product Configurator Transaction

        Use the new Price Total Summary Section Visibility attribute. It's of Input type on the Product

  Speed up quoting and improve accuracy by using the new Data Processing Engine definition to

  CSV files, the import process populates default child lines for bundled products, and default quote


    860

  line item attributes and their values. Users can also import static product bundles and products with

  steps previously required to add and map currency fields.

Advanced Approvals

As an approval designer, use custom flow logic to auto-approve resubmitted records. Approve high-value
record requests faster by overriding approval conditions easily. Enhance your smart approval logic by
configuring step conditions with eight additional data types and up to 30 conditions for approval stage
and step criteria. Create detailed approval email templates for up to 8 different notification reasons,
giving reviewers all the necessary context to act on the request directly from their email.

  Approve Resubmissions Faster by Using Custom Logic
  Approval designers can now implement custom logic for auto-approving resubmitted records,
  overriding smart approval conditions. Make sure that urgent, high-value records move quickly through
  the approval process. Approval designers can create a custom flow to evaluate any necessary criteria,
  including checks against the prior submission details. Simplify this verification by using the new Get
  Previous Related Record Details invocable action within the flow to easily capture the previously
  submitted record's details. The new Use Custom Auto Approval Logic field on the approval step then
  stores the custom flow’s decision value to determine if the step is auto-approved.
  Improve Approval Reviews with Custom Email Templates for Key Approval Paths
  Give approval designers the ability to use Lightning or Visualforce email templates. Designers can
  associate these templates with specific approval steps or the entire workflow. They can configure these
  templates for up to 8 different notification reasons that are relevant to approval submitters and
  reviewers. Previously, the custom email templates configured within the approval workflow lacked
  advanced formatting capabilities and didn’t support custom submitter emails. Use the new templates
  to show complex record data in structured formats, such as tables and images, so that your approval
  reviewers have all the necessary context to act on the requests directly from their email.
  Process Smart Approvals Faster by Skipping Condition Checks
  Give approval designers the option to skip the evaluation of the entry conditions in an approval step
  within a smart approval process. Help them save approval processing time by skipping unnecessary
  condition checks from resubmission evaluation based on your workflow’s context. For instance, if the
  submitted record description is empty during resubmission, designers can skip the condition if it’s
  irrelevant to the evaluation.
  Define Complex Smart Approval Logic with More Data Types
  Configure the approval step entry conditions in an approval workflow by using nine additional data
  types, such as Date Time, Boolean, and Currency. Previously, you could define conditions for only the
  Text and Number data types. Help approval designers build complex and precise smart approval logic
  that aligns closely with your business rules, and reduce manual review time. For example, set a Date
  step entry condition that requires an approval step during resubmission only if the resubmission date
  is after a certain date.
  Manage Complex Workflows Easily by Adding More Conditions
  Define up to 30 conditions for an approval stage exit, approval step entry, and approval step exit in an
  approval workflow. Previously, you defined a maximum of 10 conditions. Give approval designers the
  flexibility to build workflows that manage complex approval requests and minimize manual reviews for
  their users.
  Tailor Your Approval Process with Custom Business Data
  Capture business-specific data by modifying custom fields on approval entities through Apex triggers,

maintenance. This configurable offline support puts the steps on hold to prevent fatal failures. Callout
steps on hold appear on the fulfillment plan for fulfillment operators and managers to track and act on.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions of Agentforce Revenue Management, formerly Revenue Cloud, with the Revenue
Cloud Advanced license.

number of callout steps that can transition from an on-hold state to a ready or scheduled state per
minute. Dynamic Revenue Orchestration puts callout steps on hold if the associated integration

Maintain Tax Compliance with Credit Memo Voiding and Recovery

Improve financial accuracy by recovering credit memos that are in error or pending states. You can also
void posted credit memos and automatically create debit memos for them.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions of Agentforce Revenue Management, formerly Revenue Cloud, with the Revenue
Cloud Billing license.

Who: To recover and void credit memos, you need the Billing Admin, the Billing Operations User, or the
Credit Memo Operations User permission set.

How: To recover credit memos, from the App Launcher, find and select Credit Memos. Open a credit
memo in the pending or error state. Then click Recover Credit Memo. For credit memos with tax, the
action creates a debit memo and voids the credit memo. For credit memos with no tax, the action
simply cancels the credit memo.

To void a posted credit memo, open the credit memo record and click Void Credit Memo.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Void or Recover Credit Memos

  Allocate Invoice Charges Across Multiple Billing Accounts with Billing Arrangements
  Support shared business models by separating the account that owns a service or asset from the
  account that’s invoiced for it. Configure billing arrangements to allocate billing amounts to a specific
  billing account or distribute costs among several billing accounts, based on fixed percentages.
  Facilitate precise invoicing for complex business scenarios such as a parent account billed for
  subsidiary accounts, where the owning and billing accounts are different. Ensure that invoices are
  charged to the correct billing accounts for cross-departmental charge allocations, or when services or
  assets shared among multiple parties. Help organizations model complex financial relationships by
  automating allocation of invoice charges.

Add and Manage Saved Payment Methods by Using Pre-Tokenized Data

Bring your existing payment methods from native and third-party payment gateways into your Salesforce
org by migrating the corresponding payment method tokens. You can import specific payment method
tokens either individually or use a CSV file to upload multiple tokens into your Salesforce org. Map the
tokens to specific payment types, including emerging options, such as digital wallets. Use the saved
payment methods, without any further configuration, for both batch payment processing and in the Sale,
Authorize, and Capture APIs. Integrate payment methods into your Salesforce org by bringing in external
UI components from vendors of your choice.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions of Agentforce Revenue Management, formerly Revenue Cloud, with the Revenue
Cloud Billing license.

Who: To import payment method tokens, you need the Payment Admin or the Payment Operations User
permission sets. To embed third-party UI components on the self-service Billing portal, users need the
Billing Portal User permission set.

How: To import a payment method token, use the SavedPaymentMethod API. To import multiple
payment method tokens, use the Bulk API.

See Also
  Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform: SavedPaymentMethod
  Bulk API 2.0 and Bulk API Developer Guide: Bulk API

Apply Credit Memos and Payments Automatically Based on Rules

Prevent revenue leakage, improve customer trust, and reduce the manual effort required for cash
reconciliation with rule-based application of credit and payments. Prioritize applying either credits or
payments to settle the invoices of customer accounts. Specify allocation rules in an order of your choice
to settle the invoices of your account. Use the allocation rules to match invoices by the invoice ID or
invoice balance, or prioritize oldest invoices or the ones with the highest balances.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions of Agentforce Revenue Management, formerly Revenue Cloud, with the Revenue
Cloud Billing license.

Who: To apply credits and payments to settle invoices, you need the Billing Admin permission set.

How: In Setup, find and select Billing Settings. Select an application order and an allocation rule and
sequence. Then, turn on Rule-Based Credit and Payment Application.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Apply Credit Memos and Payments Automatically Based on Rules

Maximize Revenue Collection by Using Custom Payment Retries

Define rules to automatically retry payments that fail due to specific errors, such as an expired card or a
temporary bank issue. Set up rules to reprocess failed payments based on the reason for the failure.
Define the retry interval and the total number of attempts before a payment is finally considered as
failed. Capture more revenue and reduce manual collections work for your accounts receivables team.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions of Agentforce Revenue Management, formerly Revenue Cloud, with the Revenue
Cloud Billing license.

Who: To retry failed payments, you need the Payment Admin or the Payment Operations User
permission set.

How: Define a payment retry rule set in your Salesforce org, mark it as the default rule set, and set its
status to Active. Then, on the Billing Settings page, turn on Retry Failed Payments.

See Also
  Salesforce Help: Retry Failed Payments

Accelerate Collections by Converting Debit Memos to Invoices

Bring any outstanding amount into your accounts receivables workflow by generating invoices from debit
memos. Convert standalone debit memos to invoices by using Invoice Ingestion API. This feature helps
to simplify and accelerate payment collections.

        on the RevenueTransactionErrorLog object.

        SequencePolicy object.

        Use the new ShouldCaptureTaxesAtHeader field on the existing TaxEngine object.

        Use the new supported value RevenueStandardTaxEngine in the existing Type field on the
        TaxEngine object.

when requesting tax calculations
        Use the new ShouldUseTaxTreatmentItems field on the existing TaxTreatment object.

Salesforce Contracts

Contract authors and template designers have greater control over how they structure, style, and review
contract content. Improvements to section behavior, clause formatting, and profile-based access help
maintain consistent layouts, protect sensitive content, and make sure that the intended users participate
in internal reviews. Expanded reconciliation and token capabilities keep data accurate across contracts,
line items, and related records. Large and complex documents are more responsive during editing,
comparison, and check-in. Document Template migration improvements further preserve document
structure and clause relationships as they move between Salesforce orgs.

  Control Section Name Visibility When Inserting Content
  Template designers and contract authors can choose whether a section name appears in the
  generated document. Previously, section name always appeared. They can now delete section names
  in the Microsoft 365 editor when they don’t want it to appear in the generated document. The section
  name remains visible under the Section tab in the Microsoft 365 add-in panel to manage section
  content.
  Preserve Formatting When Inserting Clauses
  Clauses now retain their defined indentation, line spacing, lists, fonts, and other rich text formatting
  defined in the clause library when inserted into a document. Previously, inserting clauses into a
  Microsoft 365 template and contract document caused the document styles to override the clause’s
  original formatting.
  Assign Profile-Based Access for Sections
  Control who can update sensitive content, including token values, by limiting section-level access to
  specific profiles. During template creation, the designer can select which profiles can edit a section for
  contract authoring and internal review.
  Control Internal Reviewers Based on Users or Profiles
  Contract authors can choose between a user-based or profile-based mode when initiating internal
  reviews. Prevent unintended edits and keep review activities focused on the appropriate participants.
  Reconcile More Data with Expanded Data True-Up Capacity
  The Microsoft 365 Word Data True-Up feature now handles more than 200 field tokens and includes
  support for line item tokens, improving reconciliation across contract fields and detailed line item
  values. Data True-Up also supports reconciling data sourced from related records, such as quotes and
  opportunities.
  Review Redline Differences in a Comparison Document
  Get full visibility of changes when reviewing contract versions. You can generate a comparison
  document that highlights added, edited, and deleted content relative to the base version. This
  enhancement makes it easier to understand changes introduced during redlining across contract
  document versions.
  Improve Document Accuracy with Advanced Data True-Up Enhancements
  Data True-Up token processing now supports nested object structures and reference fields up to one



    911

Salesforce Release Notes Revenue Management

  level, including related objects, such as opportunities and quotes. You can pull token values from
  related records rather than only from contracts, improving reconciliation accuracy for complex data.
  Support for reference fields on custom objects also helps keep contract data aligned with information
  stored across your data model.
  Migrate Templates Across Salesforce Environments
  Move Microsoft 365 document templates between Salesforce orgs while preserving clause references
  and section-level access controls. For example, move templates from a sandbox to a production org.
  This process helps maintain template integrity across orgs and environments. Before migrating
  templates, use a data migration tool to transfer the clause records, clause versions, and profile data to
  the target org. After you migrate the template, the built-in key mapping aligns the clause and profile
  references with the corresponding clause records in the target org.
  Manage Document Check-In Behavior with Configurable Async Processing
  Reduce latency and timeouts when checking in large documents with asynchronous processing.
  Check-in occurs asynchronously when a document contains more than 200 doc elements, such as
  sections, clauses, and tokens in the Microsoft 365 document. Async check-in is enabled by default, but
  you can disable it to make all check-ins run synchronously.
  Find Content in Sections and Clauses Faster
  Contract authors can navigate large documents more easily with the new search field on the Sections
  and Standalone Clauses tabs of the Microsoft 365 add-in. The search results update with each
  keystroke and show only matching items in the panel, helping you locate the right content quickly
  without manual scrolling. Search also expands collapsed sections when it finds relevant results.
  Changed Connect REST API Request Bodies in Salesforce Contracts
  The Content Link Load and Data Sync APIs include enhancements to reduce multiple per-field queries
  into a single grouped fetch request for improved performance.

Control Section Name Visibility When Inserting Content

Template designers and contract authors can choose whether a section name appears in the generated
document. Previously, section name always appeared. They can now delete section names in the
Microsoft 365 editor when they don’t want it to appear in the generated document. The section name
remains visible under the Section tab in the Microsoft 365 add-in panel to manage section content.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and

defined in the clause library when inserted into a document. Previously, inserting clauses into a Microsoft
365 template and contract document caused the document styles to override the clause’s original

Control Internal Reviewers Based on Users or Profiles

Contract authors can choose between a user-based or profile-based mode when initiating internal
reviews. Prevent unintended edits and keep review activities focused on the appropriate participants.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and

level, including related objects, such as opportunities and quotes. You can pull token values from related
records rather than only from contracts, improving reconciliation accuracy for complex data. Support for
reference fields on custom objects also helps keep contract data aligned with information stored across
your data model.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and
Developer editions of Agentforce Revenue Management, formerly Revenue Cloud, with the Revenue
Cloud Advanced license, or with the Salesforce Contracts license.

    Salesforce Document Generation

    Generate clearer documents with precise data by applying data filters, transformation logic, and richer
    token coverage. These updates help make sure that structured content, nested values, and line item
    details are present accurately. Generate large documents more efficiently, even when they include
    substantial content or complex formatting. Achieve consistent in-browser previews by using the hybrid
    file handling setting. Remove interim previews in Omniscripts to keep only the final version and reduce



     918

Salesforce Release Notes Revenue Management

storage use.

  Filter Context Data for Document Generation
  Apply a context filter in the template designer so that generated documents include only the data that
  meets your criteria. Select from predefined filters that support up to 5 conditions to fetch precise and
  relevant data from your context definitions. Adding a filter at design time avoids extra inputs, reduces
  errors, and delivers consistent and high-quality document output. For example, filter order items to
  include only products priced above a certain threshold, and sort them by quantity so that the
  generated document highlights the most relevant items. Document Generation in the Omnistudio
  managed package doesn’t support Context Service.
  Transform Context Data Before Generating Documents
  Generate documents with clean, standardized, and business-ready data content by transforming the
  context data using the sample Apex plug-in. Run the Apex plug-in after context hydration to adjust
  formatting, grouping, string manipulation, token value changes, and other lightweight changes to
  meet business needs. This capability enables advanced transformation logic for scenarios that filtering
  alone can’t address. For example, transform flat line items into a bundle with child products so that
  the document shows each bundle with its related components. You can also group line items by
  category or region so that the document presents organized sections with related items together.
  Document Generation in the Omnistudio managed package doesn’t support this Apex plug-in.
  Generate Larger Documents with Expanded File Size Support
  Scale document generation to support larger outputs, generating single PDF, DOCX, or PPTX files up to
  200 MB. This enhancement enables high-volume, media-rich, and evidence-heavy use cases and helps
  you generate complete documents in one pass without splitting content or assembling files outside
  Salesforce.
  Preview Documents by Using Hybrid Setting Across Contracts and Omniscripts
  The PDF document previewer provides secure in-browser previewing when you configure Salesforce
  file upload and download security settings. The PDF previewer now works with the hybrid file handling
  setting instead of relying only on the execute-in-browser option. The hybrid file handling setting
  improves preview consistency across browsers and Experience Cloud sites.
  Manage Preview Document Storage in Omniscripts
  Document reviews often involve regenerating the preview several times, resulting in multiple stored
  files and increased storage consumption. You can now easily discard intermediate previews by clicking
  the delete icon in Omniscripts to keep only the final version, reducing costs and achieving storage
  organization.

Continue Lead Engagement with Agent Handoff

Guarantee continued engagement with prospects by automating lead handoffs between the Inbound
Lead Generation and Lead Nurturing sales agents. Prospects created by the Inbound Lead Generation
agent who don’t schedule a meeting can automatically get assigned to the Lead Nurturing agent for a
faster follow-up and to maximize conversion rates.

Where: This feature is available in Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited
editions.

When: This feature is available starting mid December.

How: From Salesforce Go, go to the agent configuration for Inbound Lead Generation. In the Capture
Prospect Info step, turn on Handoff to Lead Generation Agent. Select the Lead Nurture agent to handoff
to and the amount of time to wait before handing off.

Automate Qualification with Agentforce

Seamlessly qualify leads and build a stronger pipeline with Agentforce for Sales. This enhancement
allows your Agent to determine how strong of a fit a prospect is based on their conversation and how
well they meet your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). Qualification helps sales reps focus on high-potential
deals, improving overall efficiency and conversion rates.

Where: This change applies to Lightning Experience in Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited editions
with the Sales Cloud and Einstein for Sales. Setup for agents is available on the desktop site.

When: This functionality is available on a rolling basis starting on January 6, 2025.

Why: Sellers currently spend most of their time on prospecting activities like lead qualification, which
can consume 6–8 hours each week. This agentic qualification frees up time for your sales team to focus
on direct selling activities.

How: From your Lead Gen or Lead Nurture agent’s guided config, turn on Qualification. Review the
default configuration, provide your company’s Ideal Customer Profile, and start your qualifying journey

Following a web or email conversation, the Qualification Agent automatically generates and updates a
Lead record with a rating. If the Lead is considered Hot, the record owner will be assigned a Task to
review the qualification summary and take an action.
